name: Voter Action Project Courts Team
subject: The movement to end the VRA has been going for *decades*
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www
body:
Knocking out this leg of the Voting Rights Act -- by weakening Section 2 -- would almost certainly reconstitute state legislatures, city councils, judicial districts, and every other type of political boundary in which racial minorities could be cut off from having a voice in their government.
This kind of change would silence untold numbers of voters and spiral our fight for voting rights back sixty years. RUSH $35 or more right now to help protect what the VRA stands for and defend our fundamental right to vote >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=032926_3&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Mother Jones: Republican Justices Appear Poised to Destroy What’s Left of the Voting Rights Act [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=032926_3&amount=25]
We'll hand this straight to Mother Jones, Team: " The Supreme Court, with its six-to-three Republican-appointed majority, appears ready to kneecap what remains of the Voting Rights Act’s protections for minority political representation. "
The descriptive language seems harsh, but the objective of these justices seems clear -- a complete dismantling of our seminal civil rights law . We've said it before and will say it again, but it's been clear long before the MAGA movement that Chief Justice Roberts has seen the removal of the VRA as one of his top goals for his time on the Court. It appears he may be on the cusp of succeeding.
During this week’s oral argument in Louisiana v. Callais , at least five conservative justices seemed ready to handicap the VRA so that it will no longer stop white majorities from locking racial minorities out of elected office through racial gerrymandering.
The consequences are simple to understand and grave for voter participation. The harder we make it to vote, the more politicians make voter participation feel worthless, the less people actually take part. Needless to say, the less people who participate, the less our democracy and our government looks like the people it's supposed to represent.
Team: We have to spread the word about this case and the consequences of dismantling the Voting Rights Act. Fuel our work with $35 or whatever you can today and help us defend the right to vote >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=032926_3&amount=35]
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=032926_3&amount=15] GIVE $25 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=032926_3&amount=25]
GIVE $50 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=032926_3&amount=50] GIVE $100 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=032926_3&amount=100]
GIVE $250 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?express_lane=true&refcode=032926_3&amount=250] Other Amount [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=032926_3&amount=35]
At issue in the case is Section 2 of the VRA, which requires that racial minorities have an equal opportunity to meaningfully participate in the electoral process. This provision has been used to strike down districting schemes and maps that prevented Black voters and other racial minorities from electing their preferred representatives. Since 1965, Section 2 has given people of color a seat at the table, from school boards to the halls of Congress. It appears this 60-year era is coming to an end.
“ Race is a part of redistricting always ,” Justice Sonia Sotomayor said, addressing the solicitor general from Louisiana, who was arguing against an existing map that had enabled the election of two Black members of Congress in his state. “ What you’re saying to us [is]...‘You can use [race] to help yourself achieve goals that reduce particular groups’ electoral participation, but you can’t use it to remedy that situation .’”
Striking down the last remnants of the Voting Rights Act is exactly why the Supreme Court held this case over from last year. Gutting Section 2 would take us backwards in time and allow racial gerrymandering to be a standard practice, silencing more voters. Just like the redistricting fights across the country, this is all about whether the party in power can choose their voters in order to stay in power in perpetuity.
We simply can't afford to go backwards like this. Will you chip in with $35 or more to help us fight back against these partisan efforts to silence voters? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=032926_3&amount=35]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/integrity-first-voter-action-project-1?refcode=032926_3&amount=20]

| | | | | **Director's Report - Week 11 of the 2026 Legislative Session from the Desk of Nick Sotille SC House Democratic Caucus**
---
| _At the end of each week during the 2026 Legislative Session, I will highlight what South Carolina House Democrats did at the State House. Here's what happened during the ninth week... But first, an important message about campaign season:_
**Candidate filing closes Monday at noon!** Big news from the [**South Carolina Democratic Party**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=bee1b85ddf&e=edbde6c9b1): a record-setting 111 districts (out of 124 in the South Carolina House of Representatives) will have Democratic candidates on the ballot in November! The final number will be even higher, as more Democrats are set to file on Monday.

**A quiet week on the floor.** The House of Representatives got back to business on Tuesday, March 24, after taking the previous week off. This week's edition of _Wicked Wednesday_ wasn't too bad as the House did not take up a divisive, red meat bill.
The [**floor debate**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=53538ed2dd&e=edbde6c9b1) on [**H. 4767**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=54822623af&e=edbde6c9b1), a bill to prohibit noncompete clauses in physician contracts, got interesting as members debated its impact on health care, especially in rural areas. The votes got pretty interesting, as they were not along party lines - one procedural motion evenly split the House by a vote of 53-53. The bill ultimately passed 2nd reading by a vote of 65-50.
**A busy week in the Judiciary Committee.** The House Judiciary Committee met to take up 11 bills on their [**agenda**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=1600635097&e=edbde6c9b1). Several of the bills they passed are on the calendar to be debated next week:
[**H. 3034**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=b76c4f99cb&e=edbde6c9b1), a bill to ban the "taunting" of police dogs, among other things. You might remember that a similar bill was killed back in 2018 after [**Rep. Todd Rutherford (D-Richland) roasted it on the House floor...**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=b644f8d413&e=edbde6c9b1)
[**H. 4292**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=fe3eb4719f&e=edbde6c9b1), a bill to prohibit "street takeovers." This reminds me of the 'HALO Act' we passed a few weeks back - it aims to outlaw something that is already illegal...
[**H. 4764**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=aae85b03de&e=edbde6c9b1), a bill to mandate that local law enforcement participate in certain federal immigration programs. The fact is South Carolina already enforces the law, so we don't need more ICE agents on our streets.
Pandering over immigration is a Republican tradition around here during election years: I remember a bill passed in 2018 to ban "sanctuary cities," which have never existed in South Carolina; far-right-but-in-a-libertarian-kind-of-way Republican, former Rep. Jonathon Hill (R-Anderson), put up an amendment to rename it the "Governor Henry McMaster Reelection Act of 2018," to call out the gimmicky politics behind the bill.
**250 years of independence...** Thursday, March 26 marked 250 years since South Carolina adopted a constitution that set us free from rule by a king. USA! USA! USA!
The Department of Archives and History brought out the original document for display in the State House lobby.
Not subscribed to the Director's Report? [**Sign up here**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=0c245029f4&e=edbde6c9b1).
If you have any questions about the South Carolina House Democratic Caucus, please contact me directly at [**nick@schousedems.com**](mailto:nick@schousedems.com).

---
|
---
| | | | | |

| | |
# Tell your Senator vote NO on the SAVE Act
---
| |
While Republicans have argued the SAVE Act is needed to safeguard elections, Democrats and voting rights advocates say the legislation would [disenfranchise millions of Americans](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=d7d3d3bbcb&e=edbde6c9b1), including married women, by making it harder to register to vote and cast ballots.This would mean that married women who have changed their surname would have to show citizenship documents that match their current legal name.Because a passport or birth certificate may reflect a previous legal name, the legislation would add a new barrier to voter registration for those, such as many married women, who have changed their name, according to the [**League of Women Voters**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=1c649613e3&e=edbde6c9b1) and [**Brennan Center for Justice.**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=f44220f256&e=edbde6c9b1) Nine percent of Americans, or [**more than 21 million**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=a1223fe132&e=edbde6c9b1) people — including those who don't have a passport and those [**without**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=f150252c4c&e=edbde6c9b1) a paper copy of their birth certificate — don't have those documents readily available, according to research from the Brennan Center for Justice. [**Read More.**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=2d9a10814a&e=edbde6c9b1)[**An explainer on the SAVE Act**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=4e2d2a849c&e=edbde6c9b1)
---
|

| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| [|
---](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=a234442380&e=edbde6c9b1)
| |
This past week I attended SC ETV’s _Women in Politics_ Panel at their studio in Columbia as a member of Emerge SC’s Cabinet. It was an enlightening discussion among past, present and future female elected officials.
I also took a trip to Davidson, NC to attend a conference hosted by Kate Barr! My podcast co-host Grace Cowan and I went to learn about the media ecosystem being built in the NC political arena, how to support candidates in gerrymandered districts, and more.
As a board chair of Red Cross South Carolina, I had the distinct pleasure of attending our annual Gala this past Saturday. What an incredible service they offer to our community and state.
And finally, the Spartanburg 250th Revolutionary War Committee hosted a special Women’s History Month event last night featuring a speaker series with Dr. Gloria Close as she shared stories of ten Heroines of the Revolutionary War.
Filing closes March 30 - Stay with me y’all, democracy is a participatory sport.

## Pentagon Plans Ground Operations in Iran
The Pentagon is preparing for weeks of [ground operations in Iran](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLHSoyAUhZ8GO5zLRTEWFNvYZdstHSIXZYPgAImbt98xr_CXZ76Zc-Z8f-7z3fjg4_rb7KSrS3OkswSqlfJ8UKxmTZE-VNacXtGmozx9fc4IqDhILmG2xofP3DVWOyIk2ZAWw9DdVC8kNJvuUIF6SPdYHs4OUgrsB7HgOA5KOmfHxuurDaQEAdDj2AoDHQDeiERvqVesA7K-ptz-TT7WjVz4pDfldkl7E_RW61GY_MVwYjid59m69O96cXGGU_Bv4ldmOL0K99lE7ks2FPhpMv_i12FNpcJ3k5eN49hkbY_Th-CLGlgH6258-O7VH0l6a_wfAAD___-wfIA), including possible raids on Kharg Island and coastal sites near the Strait of Hormuz, according to a report citing multiple U.S. officials. The plans would involve special operations forces and conventional infantry but fall short of a full-scale invasion. About 3,500 Marines and sailors aboard the [_USS Tripoli_ arrived Friday](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD0OnDAQRk9jOqPBxvwULtLQbdqUyIsHmKyxkT0s2pw-2lwh9Sd9T-_9eswPR4Hi9tMdaHlNc8S7BGTGPJ8Y2W0p4gfLltMVfTrLi_g1K1CdBC01zN5R-Mxt5e2KqFBXaJu-b4fONBqq3YLpFtMq_2zH5WncADAaNQzN0Pd6XIa-Ivt9A62hATBqrBsHLYAaEBvj0XSiBfTEKde_E0XecQ2f9MZcL-mogt2ZzyL0D6Emoab7vuvlWb4W312oKdAb5XV6x1iEmii7KG-XJefrOGXh7IhlWuWe8nH9kYmCZBdfmCWV7DAINVXZ-vOmEKh0vWhhOxyFf3j-r2Zvq_4GAAD___70gcU), and soldiers from the 82nd Airborne Division are also deploying. White House press secretary [Karoline Leavitt said](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u3CAQhZ8Gd6yG8c-agiIN3U2b0uIuY-9kMSDgruW3j5woT3C7KUbnnO_79bF8OA4ct59uJ9PWtEQ6aqDWqCyZYnNbinRS3Ur6ij7l-uL2WhBwktDLHhbvOJzL0HmzEiH1HRl1vw_zNKoeuqfxWgM86K4conqoARRpP-vPaR4_QU-6Y3OlQd-DAhhR35SDAQBnIjV6GicxAHluqdx-J47tSWs405vK7ZH2Lphna7mK_odAK9Aex3FzZT8b71SvD4H2QhJoz_RV5M6BmyunQHvVCrTQX7cWaP_zykI5lUY-nDIXyq5w3OSaijyIXlWmVf7TIVOm4hqnWCVHycVFgbYrxueDQ-A63cUA2-44_B3bvmX4bfBPAAAA___2SJD_) it's "the job of the Pentagon to make preparations," but that it "does not mean the President has made a decision." Iran's parliament speaker responded Sunday, warning that Iranian forces are [waiting for American soldiers](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2O6yAUxfHV4C7W5QL-KChe4y6vnRJhuDgkBBybiZPdjzJbmPpIP-n8v87mbGOKeflv76RrKCbTsSeqlTazUq52KZnetC9b-c6-rPst1ptBwO4E4iTAeBvT28jG60CEJBrSvO_l0CkuoLloMfdOuG5U1o9zzzuJPMwhSDXi6EZlm6g_GggBHEDh2HILEgAHIq48qY5JIB9r2dpribleKKR3edLWunJvkr7Uuu5M_GM4MZyO42jn2X02htPnDMMpxScxnNyV5EsMj-H1qM2m_XrElOLe9UzCcrcx_Yr1TxmeGn8CAAD__7yMcN8) "to rain fire upon them."
## Astronaut's Mystery Illness Still Baffles NASA
NASA astronaut Mike Fincke revealed that he [suddenly lost the ability to speak](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL8O2yAQh58Gb0Rn8N-BoYu3dO1oXeAcU2NAcEmUt6_cPkK3T7pPn06_X_f1jj74-PyJJxne0hrpUwMxU1kzRcZnivSl-izpFV3K9fB8rArUIEFLDatDH75r1zizESnSDZl2HLtp6FsNzW76Gdw09QOMiBuNs-2mYW7poXt49HZ-NN5cNdAaWoBezbcWoQNQE1HbO-oH0QE5z6ncficfeactfNObys2mswlmZ85V6B9CLUIt8ZtT5esk1HKFhVpAXzwLtVTrKVq6PKwosXJJEV8sT3-Q3Hy0B8nPnmQu6cxMTm6-VJY1oyVZGdmnKOmN9vUPC70JQ5U7SZtewcXLJTyEWppiXP74EHwdRtHB80Qf_v7M_zX026g_AQAA__8XFZP_) while eating dinner aboard the International Space Station on Jan. 7, an episode that triggered the first medical evacuation in the station's history and remains unexplained. Fincke, 59, said the episode hit "like a very, very fast lightning bolt," lasted about 20 minutes, and left [his six crewmates scrambling](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O6yAUhJ_G7rCO-XNSUNwmXW67pXUWDg4bDBaQWH77lfMKW81II41mvq_7fMcQQ1r-40qm-Twn2muk1qjMG6WGS050UF1KfiWXt_oM7Tlz4JqBYAJmhyEes-yd8UScRE9mnCZ50WoU0D-Mv6C-ahSCpFRaTyC89t56B6CcE2MfzNkGQsAIoPh1GBEkAL8QjcqR0p0EcqHlMvzkkNqDfDzym8pg89pH82htq5341_Fbx2_7vg_p254vzrzjt2oDJUun2_CjCSsyrK3khK_GKh6VreSCxciqxUKs0IohVbYetVE5WLEJuVZq5H0xbttDjKHqqZOwrBjiZ0n7E7634b8BAAD__1bchgs) to help. Doctors have ruled out a heart attack, but after months of testing, everything else is still on the table, possibly linked to his 549 days in weightlessness. The mystery comes as NASA prepares to launch the Artemis II crew around the moon on Wednesday, a 10-day mission in which a quick return to Earth wouldn't be an option.

White House press secretary it's "the job of the Pentagon to make preparations," but that it "does not mean the President has made a decision." Iran's parliament speaker responded Sunday, warning that Iranian forces are "to rain fire upon them." Astronaut's Mystery Illness Still Baffles NASA NASA astronaut Mike Fincke revealed that he while eating dinner aboard the International Space Station on Jan. 7, an episode that triggered the first medical evacuation in the station's history and remains unexplained. Fincke, 59, said the episode hit "like a very, very fast lightning bolt," lasted about 20 minutes, and left to help. Doctors have ruled out a heart attack, but after months of testing, everything else is still on the table, possibly linked to his 549 days in weightlessness. The mystery comes as NASA prepares to launch the Artemis II crew around the moon on Wednesday, a 10-day mission in which a quick return to Earth wouldn't be an option. Thieves Swipe 12 Tons of KitKat Bars Thieves stole a truck carrying more than 413,000 KitKat bars somewhere between Italy and Poland last week, and the vehicle and its are still missing. The shipment left a Nestle factory in central Italy and was headed to distribution points across Europe, but never reached its destination. Nestle did not say where along the 800-mile route the truck disappeared. The company warned the stolen bars could pop up in unofficial sales channels but said each one is traceable through a . A : "We've always encouraged people to have a break with KitKat, but it seems thieves have taken the message too literally." body:
A team of researchers led by a paleontologist from the University of Texas at Austin discovered [dozens of fossils](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OgzAQhJ8GOtDaxj8ULq5Jl2uvRI69wEqbGGErJG9_Iro3uO7TjPSNND_X6RqI6bF8hzv6-prz9MCjMNaK-0QRw4JzLoW4VCwcCsbMeZkkSNOB6hRMKRC_p6FN_gZpFC16Ye3gjNPCtKt3oPRNBCfdLcqkXEqjAYPBOJitsWNL_pSBUiAECK17NSQ5WIhaOA1Wh2YATFTz3tcVK75Cmfmdn7j3Md9b9mutW2nUVyMvjbwcx9HHdc-Ps23khWnGMyZOfxj2SpFP-sg6itiFBbsYnthJKQZt1dhv69buPm0HMVMxthlguQfiz2j931VPL38DAAD__6xNfAw) from several Ice Age creatures in Bender's Cave in Comal County, marking the first time such remains have been found in Central Texas.

| | |

| [](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkMuOnTAMQL8m7C5yHhBYZFFpdHfTbZeRIQYsBYKScGfm7yumVX-gW58j2zq_3v07cuRj_Yk7ufq5JH_QR4lUK2XPM-FKSyqFY6lUIhaaU0yrV6D6B-iHBh-Q45c3TXAThFE25KS1ZuiHTvbN5mQHZjKjDXKyA5ll0gEtqAFHM5NV0LC7l4HWICXIrmu1CcpYmDs5dGA7FAYocE25rRtV-sSyxK_0otzOaW-i22o9i9A_hHoK9eTjRaW2S05HZcpYbutG-nnV3Zd05ZmEfqMdOQrV38OdAl-70G8ncnicmOtBuWx8_uUz7ifyenwb_6Ac4GHA-j8ZroMregPjoMDY3somu3B-cIxceisMrPfB75fr_4V-OfU7AAD__wM0kew) | |
# Monday, March 30, 2026
---|---
**Good Morning!** On this day in 1870, U.S. President Ulysses S. Grant signed legislation that ended Congressional Reconstruction and [readmitted](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2OqzAUxfHVmA50rz-hcPEaurx2SmTwBSw5OLKtEHY_IluY6l-dX3F-HtPDhRiO7b97kq2fNU0HnSVSrZSnsJDbaE2lhFgqlegKLSmmbeLAdQuiFTB5F-I1ycbbGfyADVk0Rva6V6ib3c6D0WbQwijAedYScUHRz72B1XnCoQn2xkAIQARUqhPSc2lgUdgrMMoxCeRDTbmrO1X6uLLGK70pd0t6NtHutb4KE_8YHxkfz_PsatldOmI4qEt5Y3z8rlrvrna-7jA-0lHzXcQemmz96wwxhqINk7A9XYhfvf7tk7flvwEAAP__B1x0mQ) Texas to the Union. Researchers were surprised by what they discovered when they went swimming in a Central Texas cave. Get [the details](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDuOpDAQhk8DWSHbPAwBwSadzaYbompcpksq7JFd28zcftWtvcHE_6f_9edj-0AWTsdvPGnVr5i3RFcVUqWy8U54UMy1slSlKlhpz5KPzRk3gemhN1tAlu9taMN6N2GxLa3W-2Ge5tFO7WOdzDgtZKMPdyIze7_4cQjOO-vJ3ym0vL7MTN8ba40dx64fghu82Uc7j8aP2AyGAmsunT5I6QtrlO_8pNLt-Wxlfah-1qb_1bhb427XdXUcpe5MaacX0rjb_wmQIxyMSUFz0cyVAFMATC9YAcuJgUUyFBJUfhLE_DcF4AQ7JS0o8M6HHd9agcilKiifBLNblqUta_i8WITr5JvBHCeyvHvqz959ru5fAAAA__-3AJHW) in today's _Roundup_. ## Ice Age Fossils Found in Comal County Cave
A team of researchers led by a paleontologist from the University of Texas at Austin discovered [dozens of fossils](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OgzAQhJ8GOtDaxj8ULq5Jl2uvRI69wEqbGGErJG9_Iro3uO7TjPSNND_X6RqI6bF8hzv6-prz9MCjMNaK-0QRw4JzLoW4VCwcCsbMeZkkSNOB6hRMKRC_p6FN_gZpFC16Ye3gjNPCtKt3oPRNBCfdLcqkXEqjAYPBOJitsWNL_pSBUiAECK17NSQ5WIhaOA1Wh2YATFTz3tcVK75Cmfmdn7j3Md9b9mutW2nUVyMvjbwcx9HHdc-Ps23khWnGMyZOfxj2SpFP-sg6itiFBbsYnthJKQZt1dhv69buPm0HMVMxthlguQfiz2j931VPL38DAAD__6xNfAw) from several Ice Age creatures in Bender's Cave in Comal County, marking the first time such remains have been found in Central Texas. Swimming through the water-filled cave with snorkels and goggles, researchers [found](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OqzAQhZ_GdEbjHwwpXNyGLrfdEk3sAbwyOLKdkLz9iuwjbPtp9M055-s6XTHEsC__cSNbX3OadjpKpFopT8ERLjSnUkIslUrEQi7FtEwSpOGguILJY4jvSTfe3sBfRENW9L0ezNAJ06xWKKVx8EL1xphhEEDaz0ZeJNygd7Nvgj1loBQIAaLrWqW91D24Tgwd9B0yDeRDTbmtK1V6YZnjOz0pty5tTbRrrffC1D8mRybH4zja77K0j89lS_7B5Hh2YnI8HzE5gvpFPDjiuBDHPWwYC8fd8xJPmmZOmOvK11Bqym8-p8fuedi5o71mjPyj5wdWytzhk5gcm2z9_QgxhmJ6pmHZMMRPyPq3aZ9W_gQAAP__Uj6NiQ) armor plates from a pampathere--an extinct mammal resembling a lion-sized armadillo--the claw of a giant ground sloth, and fossils from a giant tortoise, mastodon, and saber-toothed cat. "_There were fossils everywhere, just everywhere, in a way that I haven't seen in any other cave_ ," [said](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2OgzAQBOCnMR3INv6BwsU1dLn2SrSxN2SlBSNsheTtT4nuDa4e6RvN_FzmCxDTtnzDiqE-b3ne8CyMteIxU0RY8JZLIS4VC0PBmDkvs5batbJvezknIH7NpknhKtOoGgzKezO4wSrX3MNgtPe9G0eIKONo1HUckkuIWkdnr6qh8MZk30ulpLK2603Sxsto1WCltyCMxEQ1H129Y8UnlBu_8gOPLua14XCvdS-i_xJ6Eno6z7Pb814ivWOhpxIJt4hCTwvBVls4VkjEnNu_YW2EB7YfWOipOULaT2Km4rwwclmB-NNU__fPI-jfAAAA__92qHpw) John Moretti of the UT Jackson School of Geosciences. He and a local caver visited the site six times from March 2023 to November 2024 and published their findings this month in the journal Quaternary Research. The mastodon and giant ground sloth were forest dwellers, and the pampathere and giant tortoise needed a warm climate to survive. All of the fossils are polished and rounded, and exhibit red mineralization, suggesting a [flooding or erosion event](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2unDAQQOGngQ7kX8wtXKShu2lTosEeYKQBr_Bo2c3TR5tXuPWRvuL8-Z6_gZjO7TccGOW1lvnEuzKK4DVTQthwLbUSV8HKUDEVLttslBk6ZTur5gzE79m1OS4qf-kWow7BjcPo9dDuMaW0pODtEpx1YFZckzX6CxZtBu_U2FL8YMpapbXS3vfWZeOCSl6PXgUPjVOYScrVy46CL6grv8sTrz6Vo-W4izxqY381ZmrMdN93D4U_rTETXEKJsTZmYipnV-kv5g6uAzIxlw7ORHhKJ-WSQhVrZ6wKSnln-l0Obq-YHzcxUx1C49R2AP23W_nZrWc0_wIAAP__R71-3Q) swept them into the cave.

Two landmark legal rulings came out last week, both of which will have massive ramifications for years to come.
Last Thursday, a Los Angeles jury ruled that Meta and YouTube were negligent for designing addictive features such as infinite scrolling, autoplaying videos, and beauty filters that contributed to a then-teenage girl's mental health struggles. The jury determined that Meta was 70% responsible and YouTube was 30% responsible, and awarded her a total of $6 million in damages.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6f9dd7c2-8306-4c38-95a6-ae08011b2759?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The ruling came shortly after a New Mexico jury found Meta liable for $375 million in damages after the state Atty. Gen. Raul Torrez alleged that the platform's features enabled predators and pedophiles to exploit children. A former Meta executive said that, in their experience, 1 in 8 underage Instagram users received unwelcome outreach or harassment through the platform.
Immediately, politicians emerged on cable news programs saying that social media companies need to be reined in. "These verdicts mark an unsurprising breaking point. Negative sentiment toward social media has been building for years, and now it's finally boiled over," said one market analyst.
Meta's stock went down 7% and Google was down 2% on Thursday on a down day for the market generally. Both companies suggested that they were going to appeal the verdicts.
A legal genie has now gotten out of the bottle. Millions of families have been adversely affected by social media platforms over the past number of years, and juries have now upheld that the companies should bear some responsibility. You can easily see lawsuits coming out of the woodwork in every state, and more attorneys general are going to want to burnish their credentials by getting a pound of flesh.
The tech companies are quickly becoming deeply unpopular; if you were a juror and you had a bajillion-dollar tech company on one side and a young woman with an eating disorder or depression on the other, it would be very easy to think "Huh, the money doesn't mean anything to the company. But it would help the family a lot." Any public official who holds them to account will seem like a hero too. Meta's revenue in 2025 was $200 billion and YouTube's was over $60 billion.
Even as the social media companies are appealing, they're also advertising their new precautions for teens. I've seen the advertisements. You might have too. But the damage has been done, and newly adopted tweaks may only make the legal cases more compelling. Why did they only start making these changes when their feet were held to the fire?
I personally love that this tide has turned. Data was out as early as 2017 that these platforms were terrible for children, teenage girls in particular. Jonathan Haidt's seminal book, "The Anxious Generation," has resulted in policy changes in dozens of states. His reaction to these verdicts:
"As of today, we are in a new world: a new era in the fight to protect children from online harms... Big Tech is harming kids on an industrial scale. For years, parents were told these harms were exaggerated, anecdotal, or simply the unavoidable cost of growing up online. Today, a jury affirmed what parents have long known: Meta and YouTube were designed to exploit young people, with devastating consequences... They were negligent and dishonest . . . This is just the beginning. Thousands of cases will follow, bringing Meta, Snap, TikTok, and YouTube to court."
Lawsuits and new regulations are on tap, and they will materially affect the social media giants. These companies made decisions years ago to maximize engagement and ignore the social and human costs. Those costs are finally coming home to roost, and they will be massive, if far too late for the millions of kids whose lives were changed irrevocably. Our leaders were asleep at the switch, and a generation of kids paid an unthinkable price. For the social media companies, the paying has just gotten started.

After the 2026 elections are over, we might be able to look back on this past week as a glaring warning of what was to come.
In what Donald Trump’s former Chief Strategist Steve Bannon suggests could be a “test run” for the midterms, Trump has deployed ICE agents to airports — where his refusal to fund the TSA has led to severe screening delays, with lines stretching out the door.
**Bannon already said “we’re gonna have ICE surround the polls come November.”** Now we see Trump using this paramilitary force in the middle of his funding standoff with Democrats in Congress, who insist upon basic accountability measures for ICE agents.
Of course, ICE doesn’t have any business in monitoring polling places. And the federal government does not have the authority to manage elections.
But Trump has made no secret of his desire for Republicans to “take over” the voting process. **And even the threat of sending ICE agents to the polls — who could intimidate voters into staying home, or pluck people out of line for harassment based on the color of their skin — could amount to meaningful interference in our elections.**

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CAMPAIGN FOR DEMOCRACY PAC
body:
I am writing with an urgent ask to make a contribution to Jon Ossoff's campaign for U.S. Senate before tomorrow's FEC fundraising deadline ends.

**Good morning, everyone.**
I am writing with an urgent ask to make a contribution to Jon Ossoff's campaign for U.S. Senate before tomorrow's FEC fundraising deadline ends at midnight.
He needs your help today -- not next week or next month -- but today. Here's why:
As you read this, Jon is getting pummeled with attack ads by multiple Republican opponents ahead of their primary. At the same time, he has to conserve his money for a tough general election. The situation is not great.
So at the end of this FEC deadline, they are going to take stock of where they are and make some difficult decisions about spending and how to best defend this seat. But unlike his Republican opponents, the overwhelming majority of donations he receives comes from people chipping-in a few bucks at a time.
[**So please - contribute $3 or whatever you can afford to Jon Ossoff's campaign before this FEC fundraising deadline comes to a close and they make some difficult budget decisions.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/newsom-ossoff?refcode=newsom-em250331&refcode2=2918_4767699_9Z6xd1&akid=2918%2E4767699%2E9Z6xd1)
[CONTRIBUTE NOW](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/newsom-ossoff?refcode=newsom-em250331&refcode2=2918_4767699_9Z6xd1&akid=2918%2E4767699%2E9Z6xd1)
Otherwise, here is the truth:
Jon Ossoff is the only Democratic Senator up for re-election in a state won by Donald Trump. That makes him Republicans' top-target this cycle.
And God help us if Jon Ossoff loses. It means Democrats have virtually no chance of taking back the Senate. None.
So I am reaching out as part of a last-ditch effort to help Jon before this deadline ends. Because when it does, he is legally required to report what he has raised. The number of donations he received will be public as well.
That is why he is hoping for a huge number of donations before it ends. And given the critical importance of this race -- and of this moment -- I told him directly that I was willing to help.
[**Please - your $3 donation to Jon Ossoff before this FEC deadline will be a great rebuke to Donald Trump and Republican efforts to hold onto the Senate. If we stop them, we can effectively end Donald Trump's presidency.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/newsom-ossoff?refcode=newsom-em250331&refcode2=2918_4767699_9Z6xd1&akid=2918%2E4767699%2E9Z6xd1)

name: Barack Obama
subject: That means all of us
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, John Bisognano, President
body:
This is about preserving our democracy not just for November, but for decades to come.

---
Peter, here’s something I believe in strongly: Politicians shouldn’t get to draw their own district lines and hand-pick their own voters. **Citizens should get to decide who represents them. ** That’s how democracy is supposed to work. And it’s why Eric Holder and I teamed up to build the National Democratic Redistricting Committee with a mission of fighting for fair maps. The truth is not everyone wants to play by the rules. In the last year, we’ve witnessed Republican-controlled states take the unprecedented step of redrawing their congressional maps in the middle of the decade. They even admitted they’re doing this to gain an unfair advantage in the midterm elections. As Democrats, we can’t just copy the same bad behavior. Nobody wants to see us abandon the rule of law or show zero regard for the truth. If that’s how Democrats fight back, then we lose what we’re fighting for in the first place. **But that doesn’t mean we have to sit on our hands, either.** We can’t pretend this redistricting crisis isn’t happening. That’s why states like California and Virginia have decided to fight back in a way that lets the people decide — putting referendums on the ballot that would temporarily level the playing field by ensuring Republicans can’t gerrymander their way to a House majority in the midterms. California voters overwhelmingly approved that approach last fall. Next month, Virginians have the opportunity to do the same. Right now, volunteers are actively organizing to help get out the vote in this special election — in the first weekend of early voting, our team reached over 350,000 Virginians. Make no mistake: Republicans are desperate to hold onto power and avoid accountability. But this movement was built to stop them. We might not be able to outspend the powerful interests on the other side, but we can out-organize them, out-work them, and outlast them. **Each of us has a role to play to help preserve our democracy — not just in November, but for decades to come.[Will you make a donation to the NDRC today and invest in this critical pro-democracy work?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128341007/611043018/-1096702678?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_MarchObamaNOR2_email_20260330-NDRC-Tier1-MarchObamaNOR2_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260330-NDRC-Tier1-MarchObamaNOR2_&utm_campaign=MarchObamaNOR2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFmMGEyNDY4LTM4MmMtZjExMS05YTQ4LTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=h2TC5zYSHHLH1v12saC_9IMFRKRHuKctn2O9FVJUHKQ=)** Let’s go, Barack Obama | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128341017/611043043/-1096702678?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_MarchObamaNOR2_email_20260330-NDRC-Tier1-MarchObamaNOR2_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260330-NDRC-Tier1-MarchObamaNOR2_&utm_campaign=MarchObamaNOR2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFmMGEyNDY4LTM4MmMtZjExMS05YTQ4LTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=h2TC5zYSHHLH1v12saC_9IMFRKRHuKctn2O9FVJUHKQ=)

**Trump has told us EXACTLY what he wants to do to our democracy, friend.**
And we can’t waste any time. That’s why we’re rallying thousands of Democrats across the country to band together **to defend voting rights.**

Republicans are already trying to put Trump’s plan into action by destroying voting rights and trying to **disenfranchise more than 20 million US citizens.**

Hi Peter,

**Tomorrow marks the last day of Women’s History Month.** Before we close out the month, we wanted to send a reminder about why Women’s History Month was created in the first place: The problem - Women were missing from history.
* History books were overwhelmingly about men.
* Women’s contributions were treated as side notes (if mentioned at all).

In 1980, after growing national pressure, President Jimmy Carter issued a proclamation for **National Women’s History _Week._** Educators, the Congressional Women’s Caucus, and political leaders like Barbara Mikulski kept working and, in 1987, Congress voted to make it a full month.

**The rights – and recognition – women have today were NOT just handed to us by the men in power.** Women fought tirelessly for them. They committed to never giving up and won SO MANY critical battles. We owe it to those women to defend against the backslide that powerful forces of 2026 (MAGA, AI, tech giants, the manosphere, etc...) are threatening to make real.

Before we close out the month, we wanted to send a reminder about why Women’s History Month was created in the first place: The problem - Women were missing from history. History books were overwhelmingly about men. Women’s contributions were treated as side notes (if mentioned at all). In 1980, after growing national pressure, President Jimmy Carter issued a proclamation for National Women’s History Week. Educators, the Congressional Women’s Caucus, and political leaders like Barbara Mikulski kept working and, in 1987, Congress voted to make it a full month. The rights – and recognition – women have today were NOT just handed to us by the men in power. Women fought tirelessly for them. They committed to never giving up and won SO MANY critical battles. This week we went up on TV and digital with three new ads — and they're making waves.
The first highlights President Trump's overwhelming endorsement of Lt. Governor Burt Jones — the only Trump-endorsed candidate in the race for Governor of Georgia.
The second and third expose Rick Jackson for what he is — a Never-Trumper trying to buy his way into the Governor's mansion on a bed of lies. He bankrolled Never-Trumpers like Liz Cheney and Geoff Duncan, profited off of Planned Parenthood, and just this week had an active job listing seeking doctors to perform transgender surgeries.

Peter, some campaigns manufacture fake deadlines to pressure you
into giving. We don't do that.

Our upcoming FEC deadline is real. It’s federally mandated, and we’re
required by law to publicly report our fundraising — and right now, we
have less than 48 hours to close a $500,000 gap.

This is one of the most important moments of this campaign. Here’s why:

* After midnight tomorrow, every campaign’s financial report becomes
public. Pundits and the press will line up our numbers next to our
opponents’.
* If our report shows real strength, we earn more attention, more
endorsements, and more momentum to grow this movement.
* If we fall short, the establishment will try to write us off before
voters ever have their say.

That’s the reality of how this system works, and that’s why it’s so
important to file the strongest report possible.

But because I’ve never taken corporate PAC or AIPAC money and I never
will, I’m solely relying on grassroots support to fuel this campaign.

So, with that in mind: [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20260330-1-ak.4vd5RG&amount=10&refcode=em20260330-1893&t=1004&akid=1893%2E251025%2E5_NZzr ]Will you pitch in $10 or whatever

I know this isn't easy. Money is tight for a lot of folks right now. But

I appreciate you more than I can say.

In solidarity,

Abdul

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: Aphasia makes it more difficult for me to speak
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
But I have not lost my voice.
#

Friends --
Fifteen years ago, I was shot.
A gunman shot me in the head while I was meeting with constituents in front of a grocery store in Tucson.
The bullet damaged the left hemisphere of my brain, where the language function sits. Ever since, aphasia has been a part of my life. When I speak, the words are there in my head. It’s just hard for me to get them out.
**Aphasia makes it harder for me to speak. But I have not lost my voice.**
With a lot of practice I have found new ways to communicate. But in the fight to make our communities safer from gun violence, it is our collective voices that speak loudest.
My hope is that we can communicate together to elected officials, and our opponents in the gun lobby, that our movement to make our communities safer from gun violence is as large and passionate as ever.
Tuesday is our first end-of-quarter deadline of the year. These deadlines are an important test for our gun safety movement, as both our adversaries and our allies will look to see if we have the resources to elect gun safety champions.
So I am asking:

# **Iran 's missile system is North Korea's creation, with regime providing technology since 2005: report**
Iran's vast missile system threatening the U.S. and Israel **[was developed by North Korea,](https://substack.com/redirect/f22091cc-57b2-440a-937d-069fc134dec6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** according to Bruce Bechtol, co-author of "Rogue Allies: The Strategic Partnership Between Iran and North Korea." The missile Iran launched at Diego Garcia--roughly 2,500 miles away--was a Musudan, with Iran buying 19 from North Korea and taking delivery in 2005, meaning "they have had this capability since 2005 -- and this is no 'secret weapon.'" North Korea constructed a large missile test facility at Emamshahr in Iran's Fars Province and a tracking facility at Tabas in South Khorasan province.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f22091cc-57b2-440a-937d-069fc134dec6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Why it matters:** North Korea proliferated around 150 No Dong systems to Iran in the late 1990s and contracted to build a No Dong facility in Iran, which produces the Shahab-3--"almost an exact copy of the No Dong"--as well as the Emad (1,087-mile range) and Ghadr (1,212-mile range) used to target Israel, Arab neighbors, and U.S. bases. The North Koreans also spawned the Khorramshahr-4, which carries a warhead "larger than any other in Iran's missile inventory" weighing 1.5 to 2 tons armed with "what appears to be cluster munitions."
* **The partnership:** Bechtol described the strategic relationship: "North Korea is the seller and Iran is the buyer. North Korea proliferates weapons systems, technology, parts and components, technicians, engineers and specialists and military capabilities (such as the building of underground facilities) to Iran. Iran pays North Korea with cash and oil. Simple as that." He said the only way to stop this is through robust sanctions enforcement against North Korea, going after "banks, front companies and cyber entities in order to squeeze the money and contain or destroy the supply chain" and using the Proliferation Security Initiative, noting "if you cut off the supply chain, you cut off the proliferation."

* * *
# **3,500 US troops arrive in Middle East on USS Tripoli as Iran warns American forces will be killed if Trump orders ground invasion**
A force of **[3,500 US sailors and Marines arrived in the Middle East](https://substack.com/redirect/3ad4a99d-857a-4771-8c93-0b87922e642f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** aboard the USS Tripoli over the weekend, bringing transport and strike fighter aircraft, assault and tactical assets, with the Pentagon allegedly preparing for weeks of boots-on-the-ground operations in Iran, according to US Central Command. Sources told The Washington Post that roughly 10,000 American troops are being considered for deployment to boost the already significant military presence in the Gulf region, though the troop movement would fall short of a full-scale invasion.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3ad4a99d-857a-4771-8c93-0b87922e642f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Why it matters:** Iranian parliament speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf warned that any deployment of ground forces would be met with widespread retaliation, saying Tehran's forces are "waiting for the arrival of American troops on the ground to set them on fire and punish their regional partners forever," according to state media. Trump has repeatedly suggested US troops could be deployed to secure Iran's nuclear facilities and the Strait of Hormuz, a critical trade route currently under Tehran's control, though he has not publicly acknowledged the Pentagon's proposal.
* **The tensions:** Ghalibaf, believed to be among top Iranian officials negotiating with mediators, suggested no peace talks could go forward as long as the US continues building up forces in the region, ultimately slamming a proposal for peace talks in Pakistan as a cover for the looming American invasion. Secretary of State Marco Rubio maintains the US can meet its objectives "without any ground troops," while the White House says Trump has been given "maximum optionality" on how to proceed.

* * *
# **Border Czar Tom Homan blasts Democrats for holding DHS funding hostage over ICE enforcement tactics**
White House Border Czar Tom Homan **[accused congressional Democrats of trying to force policy changes](https://substack.com/redirect/7fc85b90-6723-4a29-bb75-4eb073cef640?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** by withholding DHS funding, saying "they want changes in ICE tactics. They want changes in policy" rather than addressing budgetary constraints. Homan argued ICE is simply following laws consistent across administrations, saying "the same laws ICE follows today have been in place during the Clinton, Obama [administrations], and now. The law hasn't changed," adding lawmakers "can say they don't want to abolish ICE -- I'm in the room. They want to change operations so we arrest fewer people."

---
@RapidResponse47
"President Trump wants the entire @DHSgov funded," says @RealTomHoman . "They're holding the department hostage because they don't like what ICE is doing -- and ICE is enforcing laws they enacted."
| 1:26 PM * Mar 29, 2026 * 87K Views194 Replies * 1.17K Reposts * 6.13K Likes
---](https://substack.com/redirect/7fc85b90-6723-4a29-bb75-4eb073cef640?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Why it matters:** The Senate passed a bipartisan measure to reopen most of DHS but excluded funding for ICE and parts of CBP, while House Republicans pushed a bill with full ICE funding, prolonging the stalemate. Tens of thousands of DHS employees, particularly TSA workers, have gone without pay for weeks, causing staffing shortages and airport delays. Trump signed an emergency order for TSA pay, with Homan saying "there is a plan to get these TSA agents paid, hopefully by tomorrow or Tuesday."
* **The standoff:** Homan rejected claims agents target sensitive locations, saying "they can't point to a single instance--not one--where we've arrested anybody in a church or inside of a hospital," and framed the dispute as separation-of-powers, arguing "if they don't like what ICE is doing, then change the law. That's their job."

# **Damning ad highlights Roy Cooper 's 2017 push to repeal North Carolina bathroom bill as he dodges trans questions in Senate race**
Nine years after then-North Carolina Governor Roy Cooper signed a bill repealing a law requiring people to use bathrooms corresponding with their birth certificate, a new National Republican Senatorial Committee ad **[reveals his comments attacking the GOP-backed measure](https://substack.com/redirect/0f2245ae-93ee-4117-a988-4bd1c110b9f7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** he called "mean spirited," "a stain on our great state's reputation," and "one of the most discriminatory laws in the country." Cooper campaigned on repealing HB2, saying he "could not tolerate it" and that "it's important that we remove this horrible requirement that transgender people had to go to the restroom of their birth certificate."
[](https://substack.com/redirect/1605a08b-eaff-40f3-8560-cc7fc030e6ab?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Why it matters:** While Cooper now dodges questions about transgender ideology in his U.S. Senate race, he previously worked with companies like Salesforce pressuring the state over the law, with his deputy campaign manager telling The Wall Street Journal he "looked to Salesforce because he wanted them to know that this is not who North Carolina is." During his second term, Cooper vetoed bills to shield kids from transgender procedures and keep boys off girls sports teams. NRSC's Nick Puglia said "Cooper promised the radical left he would ensure men could use women's bathrooms, and he delivered for they/them."
* **The backdrop:** The 2016 bathroom bill sparked a firestorm with the NBA yanking the 2017 All-Star game from Charlotte over "the climate created" by the legislation. Cooper is looking to succeed outgoing GOP Senator Thom Tillis against former RNC Chair Michael Whatley, and in August declined a Washington Post interview on transgender issues.

subject: Don't rush past Easter this year
body:
Have you ever reached Easter Sunday feeling spiritually unprepared or wishing you had spent more time reflecting beforehand

| | | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrau5gmla2n5vq64dnvun0ls09apc65egt9k9sd8_rp22sh2s8i6epr1c3iecor1chh2bs)
---
Friend of Life, Have you ever reached Easter Sunday feeling spiritually unprepared or wishing you had spent more time reflecting beforehand? I know I have. Easter has a way of coming up fast. So before the services, before the plans with family, or the big dinner to follow, I wanted to share something my team created with you in mind. [**_He Is Risen: 12 Scriptures to Prepare Your Heart for Easter_**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zei1o3g9sc2b3fn2bjtu1je6o8fm9gkf3il0800g_rp22sh2s8i6epr1c3iecor1chh2bs) is a free devotional designed for the days leading up to Easter. It’s meant to be simple, steady, and grounding as you prepare your heart.
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhfqu51ip9s98nb9t0gdfg18mbc6uv76ua5v08u0_rp22sh2s8i6epr1c3iecor1chh2bs)
---
Here’s what you’ll find inside:
---
* One full Scripture passage each day
* A short reflection to help you process what you’re reading
* A prayer to help you pause and respond

---
If you’re looking for a way to engage with Easter more thoughtfully this year, I hope this devotional serves you well. You can download your free copy here: [https://resources.preborn.com/he-is-risen](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zh322nmgvhmlkf6kt2fnel0p63a755sbbskuum28_rp22sh2s8i6epr1c3iecor1chh2bs) Wishing you a meaningful Easter season, Dan Steiner

Peter,
36 House Republicans are quitting.
That number breaks the record from 2018 - the last time Democrats took back the House in a blue wave.
---
| [](https://6s79z9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001B7Y06wKfuZ0eSuV_CLtTChdPH-pcBT6P0Tm08O6RccRsvrF51ciXSADKgNB2o3OEGjEOhBs4TrUpkAKZpYO-_ZSb4ugvQ-tlqdTc1ccuabdxSgmFq109U6XWNysTtwS3vsX5sheQWZDin2GMd73V6o-s88SWl_tNOJ0elbz6VLJ2syV3ro_j22ag9iRECowFWbL75oY69tfAq7JfHppO7Q==&c=8HxYFYOHP7q1lVtUqlyofsIaNr8003oq8XSzEJrjJiU_dvFtVwr7_g==&ch=Uscz1TGhN_NmBlYq5Y2754j6ek614UqQVRO-zNaK_SxvoNm7UGRcSQ==)
---
MAGA is jumping ship as an unprecedented blue wave looms.
But Trump is doing everything he can to stop the Democrats' blue wave by rigging upcoming elections.
In red state after red state, MAGA is drawing congressional maps designed to make your vote not count. Packing Democrats into losing districts. Dividing communities of color.
That is why what we are doing in Colorado is so crucial.
Colorado Draws the Line is spearheading the ballot initiative in Colorado that would give Democrats up to 3 additional seats in Congress. Our initiative will end MAGA's election rigging scheme and ensure the blue wave lands.
But MAGA knows this as well, and that's why they've already resorted to desperate, dirty tactics to try and block our ballot initiative by introducing one of their own meant to confuse voters. # [](https://act.chrisforjustice.com/go/18?refcode=em20260330-1301&t=1&akid=1311%2E294397%2EKvE5wD)
[](https://act.chrisforjustice.com/go/31?c0=em_ms_jct_20260330_1_ak.XDKFos&amount=10&refcode=em20260330-1301&t=3&akid=1311%2E294397%2EKvE5wD)
Hi, it’s Pete.
On April 7, Wisconsin voters will choose a new justice for their state Supreme Court. It’s the kind of election that doesn’t always get the same level of attention as others, but it carries real consequences – shaping decisions on issues like reproductive freedom, voting rights, and the rules that will govern our elections for years to come.
[**I’m reaching out because I’m supporting Judge Chris Taylor in this race – and if you’re able, I hope you’ll consider making a contribution today to help support her campaign:**](https://act.chrisforjustice.com/go/31?c0=em_ms_jct_20260330_1_ak.XDKFos&amount=10&refcode=em20260330-1301&t=4&akid=1311%2E294397%2EKvE5wD)
**[Donate $10 ››](https://act.chrisforjustice.com/go/31?c0=em_ms_jct_20260330_1_ak.XDKFos&amount=10&refcode=em20260330-1301&t=5&akid=1311%2E294397%2EKvE5wD)**
Judge Taylor has built her career in roles that are close to people’s day-to-day lives – first as a lawyer, then in public service, and now on the Wisconsin Court of Appeals. In each of those roles, the work has been about applying the law with care, listening seriously, and making sure people are treated fairly, no matter who they are or where they come from.
That may sound straightforward, but it’s exactly what’s at stake in a moment like this.
The legitimacy of our institutions depends on people believing that decisions are made thoughtfully, fairly, and without regard to politics or pressure. That kind of trust doesn’t happen automatically – it’s built over time by leaders who approach their responsibilities with discipline and integrity.
Judge Taylor has shown that kind of judgment.
But right now, this race is still very much in flux. A recent poll showed that 53% of voters are still undecided – which means a large number of people have yet to hear about what’s at stake or who’s running to shape these decisions.
With Election Day approaching on April 7, the window to reach those voters is getting shorter.
[**If you’re able, please consider chipping in $10 or any amount to help Judge Taylor reach the voters she needs:**](https://act.chrisforjustice.com/go/31?c0=em_ms_jct_20260330_1_ak.XDKFos&amount=10&refcode=em20260330-1301&t=6&akid=1311%2E294397%2EKvE5wD)

Thank you for stepping up when it matters most.
Pete

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

BREAKING, Peter:

Justice Democrats is proud to endorse one of our cofounders, Saikat
Chakrabarti, for Nancy Pelosi’s open seat in California’s 11th
congressional district!

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260330-1-sk.912Vv-&refcode=em20260330-37618&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=37618%2E1203867%2ESYTcV9 ]Justice Demorats endorsed Saikat Chakrabarti for U.S. Congress CA-11

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260330-1-sk.912Vv-&refcode=em20260330-37618&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=37618%2E1203867%2ESYTcV9 ]Saikat is our 14th Democratic primary endorsement of the cycle, and his
race is only two months away on June 2. Rush $5 or more to
support his campaign before tomorrow’s critical FEC deadline.

Saikat is the son of Indian immigrants who started his career in San
Francisco as a coder and one of the earliest employees at a successful
tech startup. Disillusioned with Silicon Valley, he joined Bernie Sanders’
2016 presidential campaign, building much of the tech infrastructure and
tools used to power Bernie’s grassroots movement.

After the campaign, he co-founded and launched Justice Democrats alongside
other Bernie alums to recruit and elect a new generation of progressive
leaders to take on the Democratic establishment. The progressive primary
movement we have today would not have been possible without Saikat’s
leadership and his belief and investment in young leaders like me and JD
candidates across the country.

In that first cycle, he helped manage Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez’s
successful insurgent campaign before becoming her Chief of Staff in
Congress. There, he helped write and launch the Green New Deal — the
left’s banner economic framework for tackling the climate crisis.

Since then, he founded and leads a policy think tank, New Consensus,
focused on building comprehensive plans for the government to deliver
economic justice and challenge the status quo Washington Consensus. He
lives in Duboce Triangle with his wife and daughter.

We have the opportunity to take a seat controlled by Democratic leadership
for almost 40 years and elect one of the forerunners of our progressive
primary movement, a political outsider who is actually willing to
challenge the entire Democratic establishment. This race and Saikat’s
campaign are a testament to how far our movement to usher in a new
generation of unbought leadership through Democratic primaries has come in
just a few short years.

Saikat is running for Congress to make San Francisco affordable through a
national housing plan, implement a bold clean economy agenda where
everyone prospers, and stop corruption in our democracy by ending
congressional stock trading and creating publicly financed elections.

It’s been incredible to watch the grassroots campaign he has built in San
Francisco, and I’ve seen firsthand the impact and power of Saikat’s fierce
work ethic and deeply held belief that everyday people can do
extraordinary things.

This is an incredible opportunity to replace retiring Speaker Pelosi — the
embodiment of the Democratic establishment — with a Justice Democrat.

Of course, the corporate elite will spend whatever they can to stop us.

Tech oligarchs have already formed a Super PAC called Abundant Future —
funded by Silicon Valley and Crypto billionaires — to attack Saikat with
false mailers last week.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260330-1-sk.912Vv-&refcode=em20260330-37618&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=37618%2E1203867%2ESYTcV9 ]Saikat helped us build this movement — now let’s show him our movement
has his back. Pitch in any amount to help him take on Big Tech and the
corporate-backed establishment, and WIN →

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260330-1-sk.912Vv-&refcode=em20260330-37618&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1023&akid=37618%2E1203867%2ESYTcV9 ]Contribute $5

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

clean_body: [1]Justice Democrats BREAKING, Peter: Justice Democrats is proud to endorse one of our cofounders, Saikat Chakrabarti, for Nancy Pelosi’s open seat in California’s 11th congressional district! [ ]Justice Demorats endorsed Saikat Chakrabarti for U.S. Congress CA-11 [ ]Saikat is our 14th Democratic primary endorsement of the cycle, and his race is only two months away on June 2. Rush $5 or more to support his campaign before tomorrow’s critical FEC deadline. Saikat is the son of Indian immigrants who started his career in San Francisco as a coder and one of the earliest employees at a successful tech startup. Disillusioned with Silicon Valley, he joined Bernie Sanders’ 2016 presidential campaign, building much of the tech infrastructure and tools used to power Bernie’s grassroots movement. After the campaign, he co-founded and launched Justice Democrats alongside other Bernie alums to recruit and elect a new generation of progressive leaders to take on the Democratic establishment. The progressive primary movement we have today would not have been possible without Saikat’s leadership and his belief and investment in young leaders like me and JD candidates across the country. In that first cycle, he helped manage Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez’s successful insurgent campaign before becoming her Chief of Staff in Congress. There, he helped write and launch the Green New Deal — the left’s banner economic framework for tackling the climate crisis. Since then, he founded and leads a policy think tank, New Consensus, focused on building comprehensive plans for the government to deliver economic justice and challenge the status quo Washington Consensus. He lives in Duboce Triangle with his wife and daughter. We have the opportunity to take a seat controlled by Democratic leadership for almost 40 years and elect one of the forerunners of our progressive primary movement, a political outsider who is actually willing to challenge the entire Democratic establishment. This race and Saikat’s campaign are a testament to how far our movement to usher in a new generation of unbought leadership through Democratic primaries has come in just a few short years. Saikat is running for Congress to make San Francisco affordable through a national housing plan, implement a bold clean economy agenda where everyone prospers, and stop corruption in our democracy by ending congressional stock trading and creating publicly financed elections. It’s been incredible to watch the grassroots campaign he has built in San Francisco, and I’ve seen firsthand the impact and power of Saikat’s fierce work ethic and deeply held belief that everyday people can do extraordinary things. This is an incredible opportunity to replace retiring Speaker Pelosi — the embodiment of the Democratic establishment — with a Justice Democrat. Of course, the corporate elite will spend whatever they can to stop us. Tech oligarchs have already formed a Super PAC called Abundant Future — funded by Silicon Valley and Crypto billionaires — to attack Saikat with false mailers last week. [ ]Saikat helped us build this movement — now let’s show him our movement has his back. Pitch in any amount to help him take on Big Tech and the corporate-backed establishment, and WIN → [ ]Contribute $5 In solidarity, Alexandra Rojas Executive Director Contribute to Justice Democrats:

body:
We do not have kings in this country. We have laws. We have a Constitution. And we have a government that is supposed to answer to the people. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/jaworskifortexas.com/last-night-14193770?e=5d8d80652b)
---
| | [ ](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=431dc8a056&e=5d8d80652b)
---
| | , I was in Bastrop for **No Kings Day 3** , and let me tell you what I saw. People are not “concerned.” People are pissed. They are tired of watching politicians act like they are above the law. Tired of seeing power abused. Tired of being told to sit down, be quiet, and accept it. **Texans are not built that way.** The message in Bastrop and all over Texas was simple and it was loud: **No Kings. Not here. Not ever.** [](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=3a41fff96d&e=5d8d80652b) We do not answer to one man. We do not bend the law to protect the powerful. We do not look the other way when the Constitution is treated like a suggestion. We fight back. **That is why I am running for Texas Attorney General. Because the law belongs to the people, and right now too many folks in power have forgotten that.** What I saw in Bastrop was not a protest for the sake of protest. It was a line being drawn. People saying enough is enough. People ready to hold the powerful accountable and take their government back. And they are right. No one is above the law. Not in Texas. Not in America. [](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=5cc96f6c61&e=5d8d80652b) [**We get closer to the Primary Runoff every day. Will you contribute to our effort right now so that we can get our message to voters before Election Day?**](https://jaworskifortexas.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2e1f50319ad85f5f9e5c11ac9&id=2119da2c7e&e=5d8d80652b) Onward,

**

subject: What's happening this week at 7 Directions of Service
body:
Take action: join the Toxic Tour, Land Day, and support frontline work, Don’t miss what’s next—events, organizing, and ways to stand with us, Be part of the movement—join us on the land and in the fight | | |
# **7 Directions of Service Newsletter**
### **_Community • Land • Justice • Healing_**
## **✨ In This Issue**
This month, we’re bringing you updates from Washington, D.C. on federal environmental justice efforts, inviting you to reconnect through our upcoming Land Day, and celebrating YESA Farm’s debut on the Piedmont Farm Tour. We’re also excited to welcome you to Sacred Village Coffee on the farm, share new healing opportunities through our Mind-Body Skills Groups, and invite you to join us on the road for our SSEP Toxic Tour stop in Reidsville.
## **🌎 7 Directions of Service in Washington, D.C.**
### **Advancing Environmental Justice at the Federal Level**
Last week, leadership from 7 Directions of Service traveled to Washington, D.C., to stand alongside partners and advocates from across the country for the launch of the People’s Congressional Environmental Justice Caucus—a powerful and timely step forward in the fight for environmental justice. For far too long, frontline communities—including Indigenous, Black, rural, and low-income communities—have carried the burden of pollution, extraction, and environmental harm. This moment represents a meaningful shift toward federal leadership that recognizes what we have always known: **environmental justice must be led by the people most impacted.** We remain committed to ensuring our communities are not only represented—but heard, protected, and prioritized.
### 🔘 **Take Action: Support This Work**
**➡️[Donate to 7 Directions of Service](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3_ZQqlt19aM_Mpt4TRcI5Xl_8w-17OXMy365yZDmi0YKkk7yFe1-FO0XlNzoHU5Xor-o1Fj_CQvzqBaOW26SkWMAcLozT_-4atG5HwpitjyWZ63WNFU0bjjuGvm9ghs5i6pyleNaBvUKW6Qna5MufjCHIFJgRBkSj2kUYkBoAIA6DroGITTeXPiLzt8sHLkm0nZJhwDLwLcuVbHwrvmUxtQQPpd8swCjxFtESkafWK9oxx8H0Pmj32MuZPeVqfoXs4VW3QVTECd8j7fXPCV38L_IRhZUji1Wmh_6HqPwn_BwYHl75SOEsROaCCqMN4RFwZ-SJnnbezYMadGrsaDM64Ztsa2Kpp7wHwBLK9Bd02fp3yCb3ck7j4-s0f_IzMtxOM/4pd/a_nxSaWBTKyeEX5_c33N2Q/h0/h001.JWTkVcU9m04ymEzpOrycCyhjOny-8FKLxIKX6pKXdMU)**
Help us continue advancing environmental justice from the local to the national level.
## **🌿 Take a Break—Join Us on the Land**
Feeling overwhelmed by the stress of social media or the heaviness of everything happening right now? Come be in community with us. Join us for our next **Land Day** as we continue building our Hoop House and tending the garden together. **Saturday, April 4th****
** 11:00 AM – 4:30 PM
5123 N NC Hwy 119, Mebane, NC [Register here: Land Day](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.yjJN_MEbNx94PLaWzZ6hWwGamPY7W-vS4bGbFoLcGE_goybYzUFubWM_2Su_UtRTY7G93yQbluOsD17qBzrHbvzu6w2bOAdjen-s9c_NnhMmW23wd2nSNqJ4UbKhDr2j-ehTQDQw8UkK0Vp3yj7zsNk3uV6l4TFtGBuKG3fB7oX7WyBTHnzMxN6IZS6Vw53qUYUEI3Yi_M1yw7HNTbRDBx0imA8n1y-2y73mx_sWyQhqwOnXAsAOloZN3pdztEzmDGLXB1iNWPqQAqUl_L2OU2xjmtspXa2tbvi4g4MMYN5B3GuYmPrdtfnx24SbA2IN68Yof1dYfsMR57kefEvUncgEDHaYLjEFK01lh0KoSiJCcOQ-J_x5f54YIfMmCGu-dFWLjvOHGBP4EKfZbtEeAuHjtngRauTI_NZX_98VhVgK82l6dUkoYDpg6pezYzgfC94KwjOFEjxutjQ7ZU7-G_nK8FbKd7hIY30MqKlyf28/4pd/a_nxSaWBTKyeEX5_c33N2Q/h1/h001.ARsU3qRI8dwYebbYdzq6F2HPWHoQbLwXagcKbkcg2OQ) **Bring:****
** Warm layers, sturdy shoes, gloves, water, snacks, and any tools to share. ✨ _Come for any amount of time—your presence matters._ Land Days are about more than work—they’re about reconnecting with the land, building community, and grounding ourselves in something real and sustaining.
## **🚜 YESA Farm Joins the Piedmont Farm Tour**
We’re proud to share that **YESA Farm** is participating in this year’s **Piedmont Farm Tour** as a first-time participant! With **30 farms across the region** , this tour offers a chance to explore local agriculture and connect with farmers and land-based work. At YESA Farm, we center Indigenous knowledge, regenerative practices, and community connection—growing relationships as much as food. Come walk the land and see what we’re growing. [Volunteer with Carolina Farm Stewards on the farm tour](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtUlf2DC84n-uImN97125CFQqeHv_gZ7drPBL4I4VOjXzXfUiJYs7OyCgWyLb0kWKNGQ7TFKP5W1j0SBy7TuIhSDzOeGedT9TWozzx081y8h360M-IEXWGn0D-NYw91QaHX-giHhRHsh4H0cgjzHhAogg0wLeK335PW6921cJb-ZcntM0YDVswYIxdUbjkRb-EOjA0E7CUIoiWRu7siYW6NTkK-SrpqFCEgfX50BmeBWERR1UarlX-t9n78hgQnt2t1zCPBYRR0pf4arSBqOC6IBTD4cib6lZoYscGIIOBLfM6Q0krpOpH_5NX8JrKSIMDLBP7oEs9GwgCKp25aX7vNZxhOBc3g9KJi-_BflQalh9ED96gmUTAcoaN1f-rPgEQw/4pd/a_nxSaWBTKyeEX5_c33N2Q/h2/h001.lDM1VmH3DtvgY2exB4C6roNChDC5x789lXYSSLDvFbs)
## **☕🌿 Now Open: Sacred Village Coffee**
Stop by **Sacred Village Coffee** , our on-site coffee shop rooted in tradition and fueled by community. More than a café, it’s a gathering place—where stories are shared, culture is honored, and connection flows as richly as the drinks we serve. name: Mark Kelly
subject: This wasn’t the plan
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
I never intended for things to end up like this. All I wanted to do was keep serving my country, the same way I have since I was sworn in to the U.S. Navy.
#

Peter, when Gabby and I first agreed that I would run for Senate back in 2019, we knew things would change. We know more than most how public service can change your life.
But I’ve got to tell you, I never intended for things to end up like this. All I wanted to do was keep serving my country, the same way I have since I was sworn in to the U.S. Navy.
I know that service comes with risk, sure. But I didn’t set out to be threatened with a court-martial by the Secretary of Defense, or to have the President of the United States calling for my execution.
Look, I don’t want you to worry about me. I’ve been through a lot in my life, and things like this don’t intimidate me all that much.
I do worry that Trump might succeed at intimidating others, though. Like people just beginning to get involved, or thinking about joining a peaceful demonstration, or speaking out at a town hall. I worry Trump and his cronies are trying to scare people out of resisting him.
But then I see millions of people meeting this moment with the courage and resolve it demands of them. People like my friend Ruben Gallego. It makes me hopeful, sure. But more than that, it makes me incredibly proud.
We’re ready to fight like hell to save our democracy. If you’re with me, please:

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
The movement to end the Electoral College is making progress, friend: Minnesota and Maine are just the latest states to join the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact.
If you don't remember -- The National Popular Vote Interstate Compact (NPVIC) is an agreement among a group of U.S. states and the District of Columbia to award all their electoral votes to whichever presidential candidate wins the overall popular vote in the 50 states and the District of Columbia. 17 states plus DC have now joined.
Minnesota brought 10 electoral votes, and Maine 4, now accounting for 209 Electoral College votes of the 270 needed to win the election and totaling 78% of what is needed to effectively make the popular vote the law of the land. Minnesota passed a slate of voting rights protections alongside joining the compact as well, which represents huge progress.
Whether it's through the NPVIC or one of the other legal alternatives, ending the Electoral College forever is a big priority.
We are going to make this happen! Keep the momentum going and put us over the top so we can end the Electoral College forever with $35 or more today! >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-electoral-college?refcode=033026_1&amount=35]
