#
A former pharmaceutical exec asked me "okay what industries are admissible?" after I said politicians — especially Democrats — should pledge not to take AI money.
_**We should get rid of all of it.**_
I refuse all corporate lobbyist money and I don’t believe we should be bankrolled by special interests at all. Each cycle the big dark money interests rotate - NRA, AIPAC, fossil fuel lobby, etc.
This cycle it’s the AI lobby.
I know as a politician these companies are going to spend a billion dollars against me for saying it but 🤷🏻♀️

body:
JD proudly endorses Dr. Adam Hamawy to build on the progressive legacy of Rep. Bonnie Watson Coleman in New Jersey’s 12th district.
#
I have ANOTHER endorsement announcement for you today, Peter:
**Dr. Adam Hamawy, running for the open seat in New Jersey’s 12th congressional district to replace retiring Congresswoman Bonnie Watson Coleman, is Justice Democrats’ 15th endorsement of the 2026 cycle!**
[](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260330-2-ah.pK5zeY&refcode=em20260330-37621&%3Bamounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&%3Bamount=5&t=2&akid=37621%2E1203867%2E8_qrQY)
**[Make a grassroots donation now, and 100% of it will go to Dr. Hamawy’s campaign just in time for tomorrow’s first FEC fundraising deadline.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260330-2-ah.pK5zeY&refcode=em20260330-37621&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=3&akid=37621%2E1203867%2E8_qrQY)**
A veteran against endless wars and genocide & a doctor championing Medicare for All — these are the stories that the establishment and corporate media so often want to erase — and Dr. Hamawy gives a voice to the silenced millions who see themselves in that same struggle.
Dr. Hamawy is a surgeon, veteran, father of four, and an Egyptian immigrant who moved to the district when he was a kid and was raised in Old Bridge, before going to Rutgers-New Brunswick for college and medical school in Newark.
He served eight years in the US Army as a combat trauma surgeon in combat and disaster zones like Iraq and Haiti. In Iraq, he operated on now-Senator Tammy Duckworth, who credits him with saving her life.
After the Army, Dr. Hamawy returned to New Jersey, where he started his own practice in Princeton as a reconstructive plastic surgeon. **Since then, he has continued to volunteer to provide medical support in disaster and war zones** —including in 2024 during the genocide in Gaza, where he spoke of the _unmatched_ levels of civilian casualties he witnessed.
As a result of his work in Palestine, Rep. Bonnie Watson Coleman brought Dr. Hamawy as her guest to the State of the Union in 2025. He is running to build on her legacy and deliver a government that works for everyday people—not corporate special interests.
**From war zones to the operating room, Dr. Hamawy has seen firsthand how our government’s misplaced priorities mean life and death for millions of people in America and across the world.**
As a doctor who has directly witnessed the effects of overpriced, bureaucratic healthcare systems on both medical professionals and working families, **he is all-in on fighting for Medicare for All.**
He’s also committed to securing more federal investments in public education, ending forever wars and taxpayer funding for genocide, and taking on corporate interests to make life more affordable for working families in New Jersey.
**[Washington needs leaders like Dr. Hamawy — rooted in lived experiences that have transformed his outlook on how we can build a government that serves us. Help send him there by supporting his campaign with $5 or more today!](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260330-2-ah.pK5zeY&refcode=em20260330-37621&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=4&akid=37621%2E1203867%2E8_qrQY)**
**[Contribute $5](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260330-2-ah.pK5zeY&refcode=em20260330-37621&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=23&akid=37621%2E1203867%2E8_qrQY)**
In solidarity,
Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20260330-37621-footer&t=24&refcode2=37621_1203867_8_qrQY&akid=37621%2E1203867%2E8_qrQY)**

Peter — Gas prices are climbing, groceries cost more every week, and hospital bills are pushing families to the brink. This isn’t an accident. It’s a direct result of choices made by Republicans and Donald Trump. | **FIRST,** Donald Trump’s reckless tariffs made everything from groceries to everyday items more expensive. Then, his administration’s unauthorized military actions in the Middle East destabilized the region, spiking global oil prices and driving up what you pay at the pump. **These aren’t abstract policies. They’re the reason your budget doesn’t stretch as far as it used to.**
---
**NOW,** with Georgians struggling under the weight of these very crises, what are Washington Republicans focused on? They know their own policies are wildly unpopular and guarantee they’ll lose in November. So instead of providing real relief, they are attempting to pass the “SAVE Act” — a bill with one purpose: to make it harder for eligible Georgians to vote. These are the same politicians who created these economic problems. They know they’ll be held accountable, so they’re trying to strip away your power to do it at the ballot box. **We cannot let them get away with it, Peter**
---
Republicans are focused on suppressing your voice. We are focused on protecting it — **and on fighting for the economic security and accountability every Georgian family deserves.**
To do that, we need to be ready. Ready to challenge these laws in court, educate every community on their rights, and mobilize voters at a historic scale.

The 2025 elections showed us a valuable truth, folks: Voter participation is increasing in all the right ways.
Voter registration activity increased across the country. According to the team at National Voter Registration Day, New York recorded more registrations for their 2025 events than in 2024, and California saw similar increases. Earlier this fall it looked like voter participation was going to make a real jump, even in a so-called "off-year".
Then Election Day came. New Jersey had more voters turn out for a gubernatorial election than they had in 20 years. Crucial counties in Pennsylvania saw their highest turnout levels in almost 15 years. New York City reached a turnout percentage unseen in over five decades.
We can drive even higher levels of participation when voters understand the stakes and feel like their vote matters , just like it did last November. That's why our voter registration efforts are so important, and why we work on it all year long.

name: Tom Leonard
subject: Congratulations and Looking Ahead to November
body:
[](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/P0EA3me92wtQtIn3thr09w/892H3whkoKTynuIkQTJegvAA)
---
Friends,

I want to personally congratulate Anthony Forlini and Doug Lloyd on earning the support of our delegates and securing their places on the ballot this November. Their victories reflect not only the confidence of the grassroots, but also the hard work, discipline, and commitment they each have shown throughout this process.
I also want to recognize Monica Yatooma and Amanda Love for their campaigns for Secretary of State, and Kevin Kijewski on his run for Attorney General. Choosing to become a candidate is no small decision. It requires time away from family, long days on the road, and the willingness to put your name and ideas before voters. I know firsthand the sacrifices that come with it, and each one of them should be proud of the effort they put forward.
Campaigns test you. They test your endurance, your conviction, and your faith in what you're fighting for. Every one of our nominees contributed to this process, elevated the conversation, and helped strengthen our party.
Now, we must turn our focus forward.
The stakes in November could not be higher. If we are going to win, it will take all of us. United, focused, and committed to a common goal. Republicans across Michigan must come together, rally behind our nominees, and make the case to voters that we are ready to lead, ready to deliver, and ready to restore trust in state government.
Let's get to work.
- Tom Leonard
To learn more, get involved, and donate visit [www.TomForMichigan.com](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/2SZ3XYxe7lPiM4QVrK823w/892H3whkoKTynuIkQTJegvAA)

| | Our democracy is under threat — and we can’t stay silent. **President Donald Trump and his allies are pushing the SAVE Act and other efforts designed to make it harder and more expensive for eligible Americans to vote.**

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/128404219/611205869/-569431239?refcode=260330em-save&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzI2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxYzMzYWRkNC03ZTJjLWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=h7uG--PZMJ3pDXPsQAezpIxjZKmb5-87V_UA5sdFzJ0=)

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]
Friends,
When I’m talking about supporting causes and organizations, I often say that I would never ask anyone else to invest in something that I’m not investing in myself.
The same is true for my own re-election campaign.
I’m incredibly fortunate to be able to provide support to my own campaign. I’m grateful for that because it allows me to focus on the work that really matters – on legislating and building relationships in my community – instead of just trying to keep our budget afloat.
And there’s plenty of work to be done – I have an amazing staff on the ground that organizes volunteers and activists to get involved in the election; I work hard to be as involved in my community as I possibly can, even when commuting to D.C. for votes and legislative work; and I’m passionate about supporting my fellow Democrats up and down the ballot in California and running in competitive House races around the country.
But the reality is that I can’t do 100% of it on my own. I’m grateful to be able to invest in my own work, and I’m so proud of what we’ve accomplished this election cycle. And as we approach the first FEC filing deadline of this critical election year, I’m asking you to join me.
Before our first FEC deadline of 2026 tomorrow, will you join me and invest whatever amount you can to help me win re-election? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=50]
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=50]
Whether it’s $1 or $100, your support means SO much to me and allows me to not just continue my work, but expand it to get even more done.
Thank you for your support! I’m so thankful for this team.
-Sara

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: We will win.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2835%2E4032634%2EgKKLzA)
---
As we get closer and closer to Election Day: The question on all of our minds is _“How do we win?”_ And for good reason: We can’t afford another two years of an unchecked and unbound Trump Administration. And Democrats winning in November is the key to stopping what’s coming out of this Administration. But I want to ask a different question: _How do we lose?_ We lose by doing what Trump and Republicans want us to do: Give up. Because if we give up, they can continue to make corrupt deals and make themselves incredibly rich. They can continue to shoot people in the streets and face no accountability. They can continue to destroy our democracy. Donald Trump and Republicans want you to think that fighting back doesn’t matter. They want you to feel powerless. To give up. To curl up in a little ball. That is the only way they win. I want to stop Trump in his tracks right this minute — and I’m pulling every lever available to do that right now. But a critical way to save our democracy is through our elections. That’s where the real power lies. How do we know? We’ve spent this past year knocking on doors, making calls, and protesting. We’ve been able to apply public pressure, leverage Congressional oversight, and use the courts to throw sand in the gears. The candidates fighting to save our democracy have over-performed in election after election since Trump took office again. We took a stand and countered the GOP’s unprecedented mid-decade gerrymandering attempts. Donald Trump thinks that he is King. He thinks he can steal our democracy. We are the people who will prove that Donald Trump is wrong. We have the power. We’re still in this fight. And we will win. **I’m committed to using every tool I have to fight this corrupt administration every single day. And I’m resolved to help Democrats take back the House and the Senate — that’s why I recently donated over $400,000 from my campaign account to 23 state parties to help Democrats win up and down the ballot in November.** [**If you’re still with me in this fight, will you pitch in $28 or anything you can to power our campaign, fight to take back our Majorities in November, and make our government fight harder for working people by making big, structural change?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3562?amount=28&t=8&akid=2835%2E4032634%2EgKKLzA) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

Donald Trump and his Republican enablers are shutting down parts of our government to expand his deportation (kidnapping) machine.
Just this weekend, the GOP blocked funding for FEMA, the Coast Guard, cybersecurity, and TSA because they’re demanding more money for ICE. They shut down parts of the government so that agents can continue to abduct our neighbors and loved ones without warrants, I.D.s, or cause. The Trump administration has deployed ICE agents to schools, hospitals, and airports to intimidate us into compliance.
And now, we’re in Donald Trump’s fourth government shutdown. In fact, he already holds the record for the two longest shutdowns in American history.
I’m fighting back with legislation, too:
* I introduced the CLEAR ID Act to stop ICE and other federal agents from hiding their identities while terrorizing our communities
* I co-sponsored H.R.7297, which would give legal pathways for anyone who was violated by a CBP or ICE agent
* My team and I will continue to show up to fight for the release of my constituents and to make sure our neighbors taken to detention centers get the legal resources they need and deserve
Congress needs fighters who actually show up and stand their ground. Our primary is May 19, and our March end-of-quarter deadline is just days away. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. # Watchdog accuses AOC of misusing $19K in campaign funds for psychiatrist
A watchdog group filed a federal complaint alleging Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez improperly used nearly $19,000 in campaign funds to pay a Boston psychiatrist for services reported as "leadership training and consulting," **[claiming they were actually personal therapy.](https://substack.com/redirect/90bc4d35-752e-4ec9-8150-2f88cb10c143?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/90bc4d35-752e-4ec9-8150-2f88cb10c143?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Three Payments Totaled:** The National Legal and Policy Center complaint details three 2025 payments to Dr. Brian W. Boyle totaling $18,725 made on March 10, May 15 and Oct. 1, all disclosed as leadership training and consulting.
* **Psychiatrist Specialty:** Dr. Brian Boyle is an interventional psychiatrist specializing in treating depression, PTSD and anxiety through ketamine therapy and does not advertise leadership training or consulting services for candidates or campaigns.
* **Personal Use Alleged:** The filing argues the expenses would exist regardless of candidacy and were not for a bona fide campaign purpose, potentially violating federal election law and House ethics rules against personal use of campaign funds. Ocasio-Cortez has previously spoken publicly about undergoing therapy and advocated for research into psychedelic substances.

# Experts warn teacher sexual misconduct is rampant and underreported in schools
Leading researchers say educator sexual misconduct is a **[serious public health concern that is vastly underreported in U.S. schools,](https://substack.com/redirect/0a7b9740-a3bb-4e88-84a6-f0c1930711df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/0a7b9740-a3bb-4e88-84a6-f0c1930711df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)with only six percent of student victims disclosing abuse despite a near 100 percent increase in educator rape or attempted rape since 2004.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0a7b9740-a3bb-4e88-84a6-f0c1930711df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Underreporting Statistics:** A Department of Education study showed nearly 100 percent increase in educator rape or attempted rape since 2004, but only six percent of victims disclose, according to expert Charol Shakeshaft who led the landmark 2004 study.
* **Victim Impact Stories:** Victims like teen Grant Strickland described grooming with alcohol and marijuana leading to trauma; he said he had to grow up too fast and almost didn't survive, emphasizing boys are often minimized as experiencing a "conquest."
* **Expert Findings:** Researcher Elizabeth Jeglic found more than one in ten students experience at least one form of educator sexual misconduct, estimating 500,000 U.S. students affected yearly, with increases possibly linked to teacher shortages and younger educators.
* **Offender Patterns:** Eighty-five percent of offenders are male though female perpetrators often make headlines; causes include undetected personality disorders, teacher shortages, and what Jordan Peterson called collapse of Western values and subjective morality.

Derek,
Costs are still too high, and they keep rising — squeezing families who already can’t afford their gas and groceries, let alone housing, childcare, and healthcare. In communities across the country, people are living in fear as Trump's aggressive ICE raids tear families apart. We’re watching an illegal war of choice wreak havoc in the Middle East.
The American people deserve a government focused on making their lives better.
Instead, we have a president who is brazenly abusing his power when he campaigned on draining the swamp; who is starting wars after he called himself “the peace President;” who is handing out tax breaks to his billionaire friends despite promising over and over again to make life more affordable for the rest of us. All while gutting essential programs like Medicaid and SNAP that real people depend on.
All of this is why this year's midterms matter so much. We have a real chance to disrupt the GOP's trifecta, flip the House, and take back the Senate. But we have to start putting in the work right now.
I will keep doing everything I can in the Senate to push back against this lawless administration, advance our shared values, and find real solutions to the problems keeping families up at night. And I need you with me.
Years ago, I started Common Ground PAC to help elect leaders who are ready to put aside political bickering, move past gridlock, and actually get things done.
Right now, Common Ground is working hard to support my colleagues running for re-election and to elect strong Democrats up and down the ballot who can defeat Republicans this November.
Tuesday night is a major FEC filing deadline, and everything we raise up until that point lays the foundation for our tough fight ahead. I’m asking you to read it all the way through, but if you can’t spare the time, I’m hoping you can split $10 or any amount between me and the Voter Protection Project to help my grassroots campaign avoid making some debilitating budget cuts before my urgent End of Quarter Deadline »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/105917?t=6&akid=23419%2E878179%2Eab2DCp)**

_We could lose._

I’m sorry to be the bearer of bad news, but you need to know what we’re up against in this critical race in Maine – and in the battle for House control.

I’ll put it plainly: My opponent, Paul LePage, is sitting on a **$1.2 MILLION** stockpile of MAGA cash.

Not to mention the **BILLIONS** Trump’s political machine is raking in, just a phone call away from dumping into LePage’s account.

Friend, listen: I _hate_ that Big Money can decide the outcome of an election – (I’ve spent my career trying to fight it) – but that’s the harsh reality we’re up against.

If Paul LePage wins, he’ll flip this seat red and hand MAGA another Majority. He’ll be Trump’s yes-man. He’ll faithfully serve the billionaires who bought him his seat and throw everyone else to the wolves.

**If I win, I’ll clinch the seat Democrats desperately need to secure a House Majority. I’ll fight with every fiber of my being against this fascist administration and never back down. I’ll put working families first and be a champion for LGBTQ+ folks like me.**

It’s why the MAGA Establishment is working so hard to stop me.

Here’s the difficult truth:

I’m up against my critical End of Quarter Deadline.

My team is recommending some drastic budget cuts.

But I just checked ActBlue and crunched the numbers.

Friends, with so much happening right now, it’s more important than ever that I stay connected to the people I proudly fight on behalf of — including you.
So I have two asks before the first quarter of 2026 ends tomorrow night.
First, my campaign is working hard toward a critical end-of-quarter fundraising benchmark, and I’m asking directly for your help. Will you chip in any amount before tomorrow night’s deadline? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?amount=50]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?amount=50]
And second — will you take a quick end-of-quarter survey to tell me what’s on your mind? It’ll take just a minute, and knowing what’s important to you helps shape the fights we take on in the months ahead.
TAKE THE SURVEY [https://secure.ngpvan.com/9saM0wMt9UeiqalsBwP7QQ2]
Here's a snapshot of what your support has made possible:
* We’ve filed more than 65 lawsuits in less than 65 weeks challenging the Trump administration's unconstitutional power grabs and weaponization of federal resources — and we've won over and over again (more than 80% of the time!).
* We’ve preserved more than $168 billion in federal funding for California's schools, infrastructure, healthcare, and research.
* We’ve successfully blocked Trump’s attempts to strip away billions of dollars in federal grant funding , dismantle agencies like AmeriCorps and HHS, and roll back constitutional rights like birthright citizenship and the right to vote.
* And we’ve defended our communities by prosecuting corrupt corporate landlords, securing felony convictions against fentanyl traffickers, and holding powerful special interests accountable.
This work isn't slowing down — and neither are we. But to fight as effectively as possible, I need to know what's most important to you as we head into the next part of the year.
Take our short survey and help shape the fights ahead: [https://secure.ngpvan.com/9saM0wMt9UeiqalsBwP7QQ2]

My name is Adam Schwarze. I’m a former Navy SEAL who would spill my blood for this country without hesitation—and I’d do it in a heartbeat to defend the freedoms enshrined in our Constitution.

I’m running for U.S. Senate in Minnesota because the Democrats lining up for what they believe will be a political coronation aren’t just a wrong fit for the job — _**they’re completely detached from reality.**_

The frontrunner,**_Lieutenant Governor Peggy Flanagan, is actually radical._** And Rep. Angie Craig—the one desperately trying to catch her on the left—is a political weathervane who flips whichever way the radical winds blow, with zero regard for principle or the people she claims to serve.

_**Here’s the latest jaw-dropping example:**_

_**Just last year, Rep. Angie Craig voted for the Laken Riley Act—a commonsense bill that told ICE to actually deport illegal migrants with criminal records**. _

Fast-forward to today, and she’s now publicly regretting that vote, whining that giving ICE any new tools under this administration was a “mistake.”

Let that sink in.

**A young woman named Laken Riley was brutally murdered by an illegal immigrant. Congress passed a bill named after her to stop exactly that kind of tragedy. Angie Craig voted yes... and now she’s sorry.**

What a pathetic flip-flop. Another Democrat selling out American safety for left-wing applause.

I’ve never met a Navy SEAL—active or retired—who would ever dream of selling out this country. Not once.

Hi friends —

If you’ve been on my email list for a while, you’re probably used to hearing from me with updates about what’s happening at City Hall: what decisions are being made, what they mean, what it all means for you, and ways you can stay involved.

Running a statewide campaign for Lieutenant Governor means the updates look a little different... but the spirit of them is the same. So here’s the honest update.

Over the past few weeks, I’ve been traveling across Rhode Island, meeting folks in living rooms, community centers, and neighborhood events to talk about what people want from their next Lieutenant Governor. I’ve been hearing a lot about affordability, housing, climate resilience, and **the simple desire for government to actually work for regular people.**

**If you know me, you know that’s exactly why I’m in public service.** And conversations like these are the most important part of this campaign.

That means it is my number one priority to build a team that can make this happen by knocking doors, making phone calls, coordinating events, visiting communities across the state, and making sure we can keep showing up wherever Rhode Islanders want to talk.

And that’s where I’m hoping you might be able to help.

We’re approaching the end of our first fundraising quarter of the election year, and these early months are when we’re laying the foundation for the campaign ahead, including growing our team.

**[If you’re able, would you consider making a contribution to help us keep this work going? My team tells me we need to raise $8,000 more before our reporting deadline of midnight on March 31. Over the past few weeks, I’ve been traveling across Rhode Island, meeting folks in living rooms, community centers, and neighborhood events to talk about what people want from their next Lieutenant Governor. I’ve been hearing a lot about affordability, housing, climate resilience, and the simple desire for government to actually work for regular people. If you know me, you know that’s exactly why I’m in public service. And conversations like these are the most important part of this campaign. That means it is my number one priority to build a team that can make this happen by knocking doors, making phone calls, coordinating events, visiting communities across the state, and making sure we can keep showing up wherever Rhode Islanders want to talk. body:
Wes Moore was just booed at Camden Yards. Our Dan Cox for Governor Team is experienced and ready to beat Wes Moore. Join us to renew Maryland! | | | |
---
|
# Join Me Tonight Via Livestream.
---
| | | [ ](https://dancoxforgovernor.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=9b19b51aec&e=5bb5efcda7)
---
|
### Hear answers to the recent debate/forum questions via livestream tonight and ask Dan your questions.
Dear friend,
Happy Holy Week to everyone!

Recent [PolyMarket non-scientific ratings](https://dancoxforgovernor.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=e074ce1355&e=5bb5efcda7) have us crushing the Maryland Republican Primary race by over 53%, with the nearest contestant (a lifelong Democrat) trailing far behind by over 21 points. This reflects what we already know: the massive work YOU did with our team just four years ago made a serious difference and the 200,000 miles plus that our campaign put on our vehicles traversing the State with YOUR movement for freedom is not over. It has just begun. There is no other team experienced and ready to beat Wes Moore and lead Maryland, than ours.

And to make it all even clearer as to the sense of the People this year demanding change, Wes Moore's governorship was just LOUDLY BOOED at Orioles Stadium this week.

Friends, we are in a race to save and renew Maryland. All is not yet lost for our Great Free State. But if we do nothing, our children and grandchildren will not have the future that we want to give them.

Please join me tonight on Facebook live for our Policy Chat to hear the issues and solutions our campaign is bringing forward, the differences between us and some of the other candidates in the race, and ask me your questions as well as I will get to as many as I can in tonight's livestream.

The time for victory is now. I look forward to seeing you tonight.

We need your urgent support - [please contribute your time as a volunteer or donation](https://dancoxforgovernor.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=df7938b411&e=5bb5efcda7) to invest in yours, your children and grandchildren's and our State's future. "If not us, who? If not now, when?" - President Ronald Reagan

For Freedom,

Dan Cox
Candidate for Maryland Governor, '26

DanCoxforGovernor.com

body:

Peter — we have just one more dayto reach our $25,000 triple match campaign goal to fund LCV’s environmental work
all over the country. And we're SO close to meeting our goal. We're just $2,491 short — and your
support can truly help us cross the finish line. Here's the situation. Trump’s Secretary of the Interior has just announced plans to allow gas and oil companies to drill with no regard for
endangered species and the places they call home in the Gulf of Mexico. This follows weeks of some of the most damaging anti-environment decisions of
Trump’s presidency. How far we can go to stop him depends on how much support we receive before
midnight tomorrow. Can we count on you to renew your LCV membership for just $15 to help us hit our $25,000 goal? Not even two years
in office, and Trump has taken aim at nearly every guardrail that keeps Big Oil
in check and protects our communities, planet, and all the life it sustains. We
need members like you to help us mobilize against: The EPA’s repeal of the Endangerment Finding, one of the most important foundations for federal protections for our climate. Trump and his MAGA allies in Congress are trying to rescind protections for Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument. If they succeed, this could become the blueprint for gutting protections for virtually every national monument. Trump’s EPA is seeking to undo rules limiting toxic “forever chemicals” in our drinking water, putting communities at an increased risk of certain cancers, reproductive issues, and developmental delays. Peter — these moves are a nightmare for the environment, and they are wildly unpopular with everyday people. Trump
and his cronies are hoping we turn our attention away while they lock in
anti-environmental policies that could last generations. We can’t let that happen. We need your help. Right now, the impact of your support TRIPLES — but don’t wait to renew. body:
The Supreme Court hears a case on birthright citizenship this Wednesday. Congress needs to hear from us now. | |
---
Peter, **Ending birthright citizenship is one of the biggest priorities for the wannabe dictator in the White House.** When Trump got back to the Oval Office, he wasted no time issuing an illegal Executive Order redefining the Fourteenth Amendment entirely. **Now, the Supreme Court is set to hear oral arguments in the case challenging the Executive Order this Wednesday—and their ruling could rip apart birthright citizenship for good.** The Fourteenth Amendment is clear. It makes everyone “born or naturalized in the United States” an American citizen. **It shouldn’t be up for debate.** But Trump and his racist, extremist cronies want to decide who counts as an American, and who doesn’t. His goal is to take citizenship rights away from the children of immigrants so he can send ICE to kidnap and deport more people he deems unworthy. **This is one of the Trump administration’s most transparent attacks on our Constitution, our democracy, and our rights. If he can redefine an Amendment to let him pick and choose who gets to be an American, none of us are protected.** [**Congress can stop attacks on birthright citizenship before the Supreme Court even gets the chance to rule. They need to hear from us right now. Send a message today demanding they protect the Fourteenth Amendment.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm396MCpkY7Ue0aOf7CTWHOaxvdZgY5OTn_sSXxZCliLQEfvtWDXoarM5DomjXoFDPtniAfwm1F7CNALdL_fCgTbIu0Fn5kM_LyK8CLu2V1Iw2JKb2sgqgCIr6JKQnQwQn-dH22rBpQ5DMtcBgWXpQn_3-SjxencxrX-DZ0M_h4GRi4rcyVHq-Mp9lCT_aVaLLyfuyEk0L3G9jS8xNyysHpm__eIrZdrryltKrItQSo_brSrhlq14VWWifm-GT96tMWAUxm8GW-w-EZnUXMEbIhhAxS5kXLqRTiEOI6nsS7353T8wJ0odxD1RqW-uotb22yyzVJt_JyTb8ul5d2Ni4bZMeJ7vIFpHLaLxxLKFFfMJS4a12EfkRlzi4B4RFljY-zE/4pd/989AU1PFQhifJQMmCcTCgQ/h0/h001.yNY5lfJUd9GYjmaeNwmmI9EGv7hHsVlvlFWKBRKT3MU) [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm396MCpkY7Ue0aOf7CTWHOaxvdZgY5OTn_sSXxZCliLQEfvtWDXoarM5DomjXoFDPtniAfwm1F7CNALdL_fCgTbIu0Fn5kM_LyK8CLu2V1Iw2JKb2sgqgCIr6JKQnQwQn-fNkRG-NsVDJQKA96XE5PYTq5g4YSInFeTwTjwVufCyLh0hkRvKGcqxUy7I4dmtB54CI-H-aO0mmwffwQ4IPL_ygVng3nf0D3McQA6agSpX4y72JL2oMCa4lKLEJyZaam00ZdBK25_69ktSlF1KEZhnU7-Whc7kZWKSqxrJeGDhjphXh1EFhsttorQTiopuGkdow0aiu8s5sSpDxhWvTS7hbPo6XlmHs81s4Uma-I9QvQ1izA7Lkf6wyqcDN5P9QwM/4pd/989AU1PFQhifJQMmCcTCgQ/h1/h001.Ra_483BnJm9a_MxrXgKeVnGWVcaHe6yL33Q04WVtAec) Only an authoritarian government believes they can rewrite the rules to exclude people they deem undesirable—without amending the Constitution or getting Congressional approval. **The Supreme Court has fumbled on birthright citizenship for decades.** In the 20th century, they let politicians redefine the Fourteenth Amendment to exclude people in Puerto Rico, Guam, and other United States territories. The Court’s attitude on birthright citizenship means politicians have been given leeway to rip citizenship away from people who were born in the United States whenever they feel like it. That’s exactly what Trump is trying to take advantage of. We now have a Court that’s been completely captured by MAGA extremists and wealthy elites. They side with Trump 90% of the time. They’ve ripped apart women’s rights, given Trump sweeping immunity, and greenlit illegal action after illegal action. **There’s no reason to believe they won’t do the same in the birthright citizenship case.** **Diversity is a bedrock of American democracy. Immigrant communities are valued members of our society, and deserve the full protection of the law that everyone else receives.** **We can’t depend on the MAGA justices to stand up to white supremacy and defend the rights of everyone in our democracy.** That’s why Congress needs to hear from us immediately. clean_body: The Supreme Court hears a case on birthright citizenship this Wednesday. Congress needs to hear from us now. | | Peter, Ending birthright citizenship is one of the biggest priorities for the wannabe dictator in the White House. When Trump got back to the Oval Office, he wasted no time issuing an illegal Executive Order redefining the Fourteenth Amendment entirely. Now, the Supreme Court is set to hear oral arguments in the case challenging the Executive Order this Wednesday—and their ruling could rip apart birthright citizenship for good. The Fourteenth Amendment is clear. It makes everyone “born or naturalized in the United States” an American citizen. It shouldn’t be up for debate. But Trump and his racist, extremist cronies want to decide who counts as an American, and who doesn’t. His goal is to take citizenship rights away from the children of immigrants so he can send ICE to kidnap and deport more people he deems unworthy. This is one of the Trump administration’s most transparent attacks on our Constitution, our democracy, and our rights. If he can redefine an Amendment to let him pick and choose who gets to be an American, none of us are protected. Only an authoritarian government believes they can rewrite the rules to exclude people they deem undesirable—without amending the Constitution or getting Congressional approval. The Supreme Court has fumbled on birthright citizenship for decades. In the 20th century, they let politicians redefine the Fourteenth Amendment to exclude people in Puerto Rico, Guam, and other United States territories. The Court’s attitude on birthright citizenship means politicians have been given leeway to rip citizenship away from people who were born in the United States whenever they feel like it. That’s exactly what Trump is trying to take advantage of. We now have a Court that’s been completely captured by MAGA extremists and wealthy elites. They side with Trump 90% of the time. They’ve ripped apart women’s rights, given Trump sweeping immunity, and greenlit illegal action after illegal action. There’s no reason to believe they won’t do the same in the birthright citizenship case. Diversity is a bedrock of American democracy. Immigrant communities are valued members of our society, and deserve the full protection of the law that everyone else receives. We can’t depend on the MAGA justices to stand up to white supremacy and defend the rights of everyone in our democracy. That’s why Congress needs to hear from us immediately. Thank you for fighting for birthright citizenship, Morgan Stahr United for Democracy Paid for by United for Democracy. | | Sent via . name: Dr. Shirley Weber
subject: Countless brilliant women
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Shirley Weber for Secretary of State 2026
body:
https://drshirleyweber.com/?utm_source=email%20wrapper&utm_medium=email%20wrapper&utm_campaign=email%20wrapper [https://drshirleyweber.com/?utm_source=email%20wrapper&utm_medium=email%20wrapper&utm_campaign=email%20wrapper]
Friends,

This Women's History Month, I’m thinking of the countless brilliant women who have shaped our state and country with their activism.

I’m thinking of women like Mary Ellen Pleasant – one of the first self-made Black millionaires, a civil rights icon, and an ardent abolitionist.

Or Charlotte Brown, who refused to leave her seat on a whites-only San Francisco streetcar nearly 100 years before Rosa Parks’ activism.

In Los Angeles, Representative Yvonne Brathwaite Burke broke barriers, becoming the first Black woman elected to Congress on the West Coast.

I’m also thinking of Dolores Huerta. As a labor leader, a feminist, and a civic rights activist, Dolores taught countless Californians to demand the respect that we all innately deserve. She did so in times and places when women were not always welcome: on the picket line, in union board meetings, and in cities across California.

The throughline of these stories is that women have always been at the forefront of the fight for progress – and often manage to change the world despite discrimination and harassment.

We owe it to these women – and all the brave activists who came before us – to build a culture of justice and accountability that does not allow those in power to abuse their position.

The fight for progress is always bigger than just one man; we can (and must) honor the movement without sheltering its leaders from accountability.

Dolores has always encouraged others to use their voice; I am grateful to her, and the other women who came forward, for sharing their stories.

As we close out Women's History Month, I hope we can all reflect on the work to come building a movement that protects women, celebrates their contributions, and empowers them to continue changing the world.

In solidarity,

Dr. Shirley N. Weber
California Secretary of State

name: Fran Hong
subject: My plan for transit
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Francesca Hong
body:
Getting around Wisconsin shouldn't be this hard
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260330-2669)
Peter,
Spring break is all about getting away. But here in Wisconsin, just getting from Point A to Point B is a challenge. Because the transit infrastructure we need doesn't exist.
For over a decade, Republicans in the Legislature have starved public transit while pouring money into highway expansion. They repealed Regional Transit Authorities in 2011 — meaning bus routes end at county lines even though jobs and lives don't. State transit funding peaked at $118 million that year and has never recovered. Milwaukee still doesn't have a dedicated transit taxing authority. And private transportation costs have risen 83% since 2000 while public transit costs have risen just 24%. The cheaper, smarter option is the one our state has refused to invest in.
[Here's what I'm going to do about it.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/440?t=1&akid=2669%2E105371%2Ej1YzMl)
First, I'm going to right-size a grossly unfair revenue sharing model that leaves cities and towns scrambling for the tax dollars they generate. Right now, local governments are boxed into property taxes — one of the only tools the state lets them use. My Tax the Rich package will reduce property taxes by 41% by making the ultra-wealthy and big corporations pay their fair share to fund our public schools — taking that burden off homeowners. And I'll restore the basic tools communities need — including the ability to form Regional Transit Authorities with dedicated funding and local governance — without adding to your property tax bill. RTAs let regions collaborate across county lines and build transit that connects people to jobs — the way our economy already works.
But transit can't just be a city solution. Rural and suburban Wisconsin needs it too. My administration will launch state-supported microtransit pilots where fixed routes aren't viable — on-demand service so people can get to work, get to the doctor, and live their lives. And we'll build complete streets that are safe for everyone — not just drivers.
And we need to address medical transit: Right now, our medical transportation systems are fragmented and unreliable — and the people who pay the price are seniors, disabled residents, and anyone in rural Wisconsin. We're going to expand Medicaid's non-emergency medical transportation and build transit systems with paratransit in mind from the start, because whether you get your dialysis treatment shouldn't depend on whether a bus is running.
People want to work. And they deserve better ways to get there. Investing in transit means more workers, more economic activity, and less strain on roads we're already paying to maintain. And by letting communities raise their own dedicated transit revenue through RTAs, we're not asking for a blank check from the state — we're getting out of their way.
[Learn more about our transit policies here. ](https://act.francescahong.com/go/440?t=2&akid=2669%2E105371%2Ej1YzMl)
None of this happens without a governor willing to fight for it. And none of it happens without you.
**[Chip in today to keep this campaign moving forward!](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260330.Qj3Kaq&refcode=em20260330-2669&t=3&akid=2669%2E105371%2Ej1YzMl)**
**[Together, we make better (transit!) possible.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260330.Qj3Kaq&refcode=em20260330-2669&t=4&akid=2669%2E105371%2Ej1YzMl)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260330.Qj3Kaq&amount=5&refcode=em20260330-2669&t=23&akid=2669%2E105371%2Ej1YzMl)**
With gratitude,
Fran

Katie’s running to lower costs for Californians, but she will only win this race if we can cut through the billionaire spending blanketing the state in ads.

Peter,
Right now, the average cost of gas in California is up to **$5.84/gallon.**
Many Californians with health insurance through Covered California are paying **thousands more each year in premiums.**
Now compare that to this: Tom Steyer—the billionaire in this race—has spent over **_$430 million_** on his political campaigns.
He’s not someone who has to think about how rising costs will affect his budget. He doesn’t live the same reality most Californians do.
**Katie Porter does.**
She’s a single mom who drives an old minivan and shops for deals. When costs go up, she feels it, just like the families she’s running to represent. Her policy platform is focused on actually lowering costs for working Californians.

Dear Fellow Patriot,

January 6th was 5 years ago...

...but for many J6 prisoners, _**their nightmare is still ongoing.**_

Despite receiving a pardon from President Trump, these **unjustly jailed men and women are still struggling to rebuild their lives** after 4 years behind bars.

Like Damon Beckley.

After four years as a political prisoner, **Damon came home to a life that had been completely destroyed.**

His family's landlord evicted them from their home, forcing his wife and son to live in an apartment with no heat. And Damon's health collapsed in prison after contracting MRSA and later requiring emergency cancer surgery.

To make matters worse, **Damon, his wife, and their son are now facing eviction and possible homelessness again.**

Sadly, Damon's story is far too common among J6 prisoners.

In just the last 60 days, [Stand in the Gap has received over $60,000 in urgent pleas](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=1f2648bac30d411d95ca3e4fff7ecaa9&_e=GfIkhgQLv6CiP0d3yn11JqjNZCAZ10ghYTrxJjtn3JTqG5rYYYohAZKQUI4nKxwS9uPCXkqblicaiOHvsz4L_gOzdYLLkCq06OpfvXp7y23p7KBOTrwv71N1kJV2Yd7tQw_1sm39fDlUtLCJUK5bcnY3XB3AU8JrAt-B_SzgosMVNGUu9FUaf3gPe095IBZUhAUi3LrWOZF0-Yz9dXO58LEOYmcF0fgMfLSIa9AKpA5k_m0B_UfVemSWmu6kuXHi3BDm2_mR7mAL6s--Pq-rGC7RuwQSV_9v5xikCGLdd0g3PCMFlllYYaAjgJ1xmk7KfqWPyl52PcTKWYQF5MBBPYQNO9e1U1E18kQ96FJBqQbd1oD4SQznBRG3_ET_L0lH6dMo6mHSbNR-gyX4RlHt4U7vDOl7O7lvf1xJDCX2hGJaBUOPNyvekyNHw5biUL8yqbMBUuEzBllhSRHyUxZiYicFG88rgSPagxjHIgKo_3sbzSJ-bE9wKNokdyFl3fSke6eTb7Ut7ES8bWXCMiyOj5pzIcUtUjutTs0cOVupIDIgMPPN12Uk1RWG-UqkZVXKTqTKPkmPKI3Su2u9GXgJP0YnpATbkOz-SNWd_eIYJ2q9CawgKbf5t8ehT1j5cEPg) for help from January 6 families struggling to survive.

clean_body: Dear Fellow Patriot, January 6th was 5 years ago... ...but for many J6 prisoners, their nightmare is still ongoing. Despite receiving a pardon from President Trump, these unjustly jailed men and women are still struggling to rebuild their lives after 4 years behind bars. Like Damon Beckley. After four years as a political prisoner, Damon came home to a life that had been completely destroyed. His family's landlord evicted them from their home, forcing his wife and son to live in an apartment with no heat. And Damon's health collapsed in prison after contracting MRSA and later requiring emergency cancer surgery. To make matters worse, Damon, his wife, and their son are now facing eviction and possible homelessness again. Sadly, Damon's story is far too common among J6 prisoners. In just the last 60 days, for help from January 6 families struggling to survive. Unless we can count on your help, we 'll be forced to TURN AWAY some of these desperate families. Like I said, Fellow Patriot... Damon's story is all too common. We recently received a request from Kirstyn Niemela, who spent months living in a camper in a friend's backyard during the freezing New Hampshire winter. Because of the stigma of being labeled a J6er, she has struggled to find stable employment. Now, with odd jobs having dried up during the winter months, she's at risk of losing the truck she depends on for transportation and work. Then there's Benjamen Burlew, who is now two months behind on his mortgage and electric bill after health issues wiped out the family's savings. If they fall any further behind, they could lose the home their children have lived in for 17 years. Five years ago, Damon, Kirstyn, and Benjamen were no different than you or me. They had steady jobs. Loving families. Homes they were proud of. And they believed in President Trump's vision for this nation. But the Far-Left turned them into political prisoners ... because they couldn 't jail all of us. Now these patriots are trying to rebuild their lives from nothing... and many of them simply can't do it alone. Stand in the Gap is their lifeline. That's why Stand in the Gap exists: to provide emergency financial aid, housing assistance, legal support, and medical help to the men and women who sacrificed everything. But we can only respond to these urgent requests with support from patriots like you, Fellow Patriot. Your support helps provide: Emergency financial aid to prevent homelessness Legal defense funds for ongoing civil lawsuits Medical support for J6ers suffering lasting health problems Basic living expenses while families rebuild their lives January 6th is NOT ancient history, Fellow Patriot. For these families, it's a nightmare they're still trying to escape. Without our urgent help, many of them will NOT survive to the next chapter. Stand in the Gap is their LAST lifeline... and that lifeline exists SOLELY because of generous supporters like you. Thanks for your help, and God bless, Shane Jenkins Founder and Executive Director of Stand in the Gap Stand In The Gap is registered as a 501(c)(3) non-profit organization. Friend –

This photo was taken when I was 18 years old – long before Congress, before the campaigns, before I ever thought my life would take this path.

That’s when I made the decision to enlist in the U.S. Army.

I didn’t have a roadmap. I didn’t come from money or political connections. What I had was a belief that this country had given my family a chance, and that I had a responsibility to return it.

So at 18, that’s what I chose. Service.

But I’ll be honest. Looking at that photo now, I think about how much has changed. Back then, I believed that if you stepped up and did your part, the system would work the way it’s supposed to.

Now I’m in Congress, and I see just how hard MAGA Republicans are working to tilt it the other way – shutting people out, protecting their own power, and making it harder for families like mine to get ahead.

That’s why this moment matters so much. Because tomorrow is our first FEC deadline of the year, and the final public report before the June primary. What we raise right now will be one of the clearest signals of whether we have what it takes to defend this seat.

**[I signed up to serve when I was 18, and I’m still fighting with that same mindset today. That’s when I made the decision to enlist in the U.S. Army. I didn’t have a roadmap. I didn’t come from money or political connections. What I had was a belief that this country had given my family a chance, and that I had a responsibility to return it. So at 18, that’s what I chose. Service. But I’ll be honest. clean_body: What unites us in our shared struggle for human rights and equity is much stronger than the forces that seek to divide us. | | | Friend, This past weekend, we saw a movement of people rising up to protest Trump and tyranny. Every day we’re combating a different attack from this administration―from attacks on our immigrant neighbors, our voting rights, LGBTQ+ people, our access to lifesaving healthcare and food support, our loved ones abroad, and more. Because we have been outspoken against this fascist president, people demanding change are targets of his billionaire bullies, MAGA Republicans, and PACs like AIPAC, which seek to silence us and undermine our democracy. Tomorrow at midnight is our next big fundraising deadline. After tomorrow, we’ll file a report with the Federal Election Commission detailing how much we’ve raised and spent, and what resources we have available for the fight ahead. Our opponents will look for weakness―especially AIPAC and their MAGA billionaires, who are watching my race to see if they want to interfere in it. It’s up to us to show them that we’re ready for this re-election fight. | Right now, political violence in America is real and we are staying vigilant. This increases the need for security not only for me, but also for our staff, volunteers, and supporters at our campaign headquarters and at events. They want us scared. They want us silenced. Authoritarians and their backers use fear and intimidation as tools to control the masses. But community protests against ICE, for trans people and other marginalized folks, and the nationwide No Kings rallies show that there are more of us than them―and we will not accept unconstitutional attacks on our communities and our rights. clean_body: Need your eyes on this| | | | | Friend: I’ll keep this quick tonight because Rachel and I are about to put the girls to bed. When I first ran for Congress, I made a promise: I would fight for the country we love and the values we grew up with—faith, family, hard work, and putting America first. 🇺🇸 And that’s exactly what I’ve done since taking office. Together, we’ve delivered some real wins for North Carolina and our country, but there’s important work ahead that cannot wait. That’s why I’m running for re-election. Right now, we are facing an important moment. The numbers we report will show the strength of this campaign and the grassroots support behind it. That’s why I am asking for your help tonight. ### Gov. Janet Mills and the Rainbow Mafia are weaponizing state agencies to ruin a small businessman over political differences. It's repugnant, un-American, and conservatives should never, ever forget.
Mar 30

This story begins at the start of the most recent legislative session, when Gov, Janet Mills (D)--acting through her Chief of Staff, Jeremy Kennedy--made it clear to Republican leaders that she would sign any tax increase the legislature proposed. The message was simple: get on board with the Governor's budget, or else face the wrath of the innumerate tax-and-spend leftists.
When I published that information, Mr. Kennedy didn't take it well. He threw what can only be described as a "hissy fit," summoning House Republican Leader Billy Bob Faulkingham (R-Winter Harbor) to his office to fume over the article. It appears that meeting set in motion a targeted campaign of state-sponsored harassment against Faulkingham that has culminated in a bogus enforcement action from the Maine Department of Labor (MDOL).
Today, the news broke that Faulkingham is being targeted by the dweebs in the Mills Administration and at the Maine Department of Labor (MDOL) for the heinous crime of taking a fourteen-year-old kid lobstering and tossing him a few bucks for his help on the boat.
According to the legal documents I've reviewed, it's clear that some political activist spied on Faulkingham and fed sycophant leftists at MDOL some line that allowed them to entrap the Winter Harbor Republican for taking a young family friend fishing. When their original attempt at railroading Faulkingham failed, they switched up the complaint to ding him for not keeping a timecard on the teenage stern-man who worked a grand total of four days on the water. (Which, by the way, is probably more time than Graham Platner's ever spent on the water, but I digress...)
Here's Faulkingham's most recent petition for review that explains the details of this silly witch-hunt.
| Petition For Review556KB ∙ PDF file
---|---
| [Download](https://substack.com/redirect/2966c331-f098-4d11-9d35-f7b9b87dde70?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
For anyone who actually knows Maine, this is absurd and evil. Only pathetic beta males from Portland could cook up such a ridiculous scheme. Teenagers have worked on lobster boats and farms and around chainsaws for generations. It is a foundational part of our culture where young men learn the value of hard work on the water or in the field, milking cows or cutting wood. You throw some hay for the local farmer, he tosses you a couple bucks. Faulkingham, a lifelong lobsterman from a long line of fishermen, was simply helping a 14-year-old family friend learn the ropes for a few days, and he had the decency to pay him a nice clip for the help.

When the MDOL realized that Maine law actually allows this activity, they didn't pack up and go home. Instead, they pivoted. If they couldn't get him on some imbecilic child labor grievance, they'd get him on paperwork, fining him for not keeping formal payroll records for a four-day favor. Give me the man and I will give you the case against him, say Gov. Janet Mills and her Chief of Staff thug Jeremy Kennedy, the spouse of House Majority Leader Matt Moonen (D).
The saying is popularly attributed to some Stalinist murderer. It became a dark way to explain Soviet abuses of power. Most Americans view it, correctly, as the anti-thesis of American justice, an expression of how true justice _isn 't _supposed to work. But for Mills & Co. the Soviet edict is a _modus operandi_. Petty balding losers stalk the halls of Augusta looking for political enemies against whom they can wield the punitive arm of the state.
This isn't an isolated incident, either. It's a blueprint for how the Mills administration deals with dissent. We have seen this play out time and again.
Rick Savage from Sunday River Brewing Company spoke out against Mills and was harassed by swarms of health agents until finally he was stripped of his liquor license and forced to sell his profitable business.
Dr. Meryl Nass was harassed by the Bureau of Licensure in Medicine for daring to share her internationally renowned expertise on health policy with the George Hale and Ric Tyler Show. The investigation into Nass, cheered on by Mills sister Dora Mills, began as a witch hunt over "misinformation" but then transmogrified into BS violations investigators supposedly found along the way.
Chris Bernardini, the former claims specialist at Gateway Community Services, had never had any issues with Maine Revenue Services until he exposed systemic Medicaid fraud at Maine Democrats favorite migrant NGO. Then, suddenly, there's the MRS audit letter in his mailbox.
What's happening to Faulkingham should chill and enrage not only conservatives but every Democratic voter and politician in the state. If these petty little tyrants will attack a lobsterman for taking a 14-year-old fishing, they'll attack a fellow Democrat for failing to properly prostrate themselves before the transient idols of power leftists hold dear. Just ask former State Rep. Bruce White, who found himself exiled from Democrat circles because he was slightly uncomfortable with the abortion-by-mutilation of fully formed human beings in the womb.
But the ordeal raises the question: Where are the normie Democrats? Are there any left? Are there any Democrats left in this state who would review the facts of what's happening to Faulkingham and not be repulsed by this grotesque abuse of power? I've seen little evidence that they still exist in meaningful numbers. Over the next few days, we can let a little experiment unfold and see which members of the Democrat caucus have the courage and integrity to call out this outrageous abuse of power.
If they can do this to the House Republican Leader, they can do it to any citizen who speaks out against their policies. It is appalling, it is un-American, and it is certainly not the Maine I grew up in. We cannot allow the state to be used as a blunt instrument for political revenge. It's time for everyone in this state to take a stand--not just with Faulkingham but with good, decent people who want to live in a state where you can take a fourteen-year-old kid lobstering without agents harassing you at the dock.

Peter ,
More than 530,000 Virginians have already cast ballots in the referendum that could redraw the congressional map in favor of Democrats before the midterms.
That number is higher than the early vote pace at this point in last year’s general election!
But here’s the part Democrats cannot ignore: Republican-leaning parts of Virginia are turning out hard right now, and some of the bluest areas of the state are not keeping up.
This referendum could help create a path to flip FOUR House seats BLUE in Virginia, but none of that happens if Republicans dominate the turnout battle while Democrats get lulled into thinking the early vote surge means we’re safe.
We are not safe, and we can’t act like it.
GOTV PAC is built for exactly this stretch of an election. We help fund the work that actually moves low-propensity and inconsistent voters: repeated contacts and voter turnout programs in the final days, not wishful thinking and not pundit talk.
With just over three weeks until Election Day, we need to press harder in the places where turnout can still shift this outcome.
